**Sales & Business Development Manager - Industrial Automation**

About the Company: A leading automation MNC with twenty sites worldwide, offers a broad range of solutions,

including assembly and test automation in Pune is looking for Business Development Manager for Pune

headquarters.

Department: Sales & Business Development Location: Pune, Maharashtra, India

**1. JOB PURPOSE**

The Sales & Business Development Manager will be responsible for driving business growth, developing strategic

customer relationships, identifying new market opportunities, and achieving annual order intake and profitability

targets for industrial automation solutions. The role requires a combination of technical sales expertise, strategic

business development, commercial negotiation, and team leadership, with a strong focus on customized assembly

lines, special-purpose machines (SPM), robotic automation, and testing systems.

**2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

A. Sales Strategy & Business Development

Develop and implement sales and business development strategies aligned with the company's growth objectives.

Identify new business opportunities, target industries, and potential customers in India and international markets,

where applicable.

Develop new accounts and expand business with existing customers.

Establish and maintain relationships with automotive OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers, and customers in automotive

electronics, electrical and electronics, medical technology, and other relevant industries.

Identify upcoming customer investments, new manufacturing programs, plant expansions, and automation

requirements.

Build a robust sales pipeline and ensure a healthy portfolio of short-term and long-term opportunities.

Achieve annual targets for order intake, revenue, and profitability.

B. Key Account Management

Develop strategic relationships with key customers and decision-makers across engineering, manufacturing,

purchasing, and management functions.

Understand customer requirements, investment plans, technical challenges, and long-term automation strategies.

Conduct regular customer visits, business reviews, technical presentations, and commercial discussions.

Develop account plans to increase customer penetration and secure repeat business.

Resolve escalated customer concerns and maintain long-term business relationships.

Business Development Manager - Job Description Page 1 of 3

C. Technical Sales & Solution Development

Understand customer RFQs, technical specifications, manufacturing processes, and automation requirements.

Coordinate with engineering teams to develop competitive automation concepts and technical solutions.

Lead technical and commercial discussions, including project scope, feasibility, costing, pricing, and delivery

schedules.

Ensure timely submission of high-quality technical and commercial proposals.

Promote solutions such as customized assembly lines, special-purpose machines (SPM), robotic automation and

material handling systems, assembly and testing equipment, end-of-line testing systems, automotive electronics &

sensor assembly automation, and turnkey manufacturing solutions.

Lead commercial negotiations with customers to achieve competitive pricing and targeted project margins.

milestones.

Ensure proper handover of confirmed orders to project management and engineering teams.

Monitor market trends, customer investment plans, competitor activities, and industry developments.

Identify new sectors, technologies, and geographical markets with growth potential.

Prepare market development plans and recommend strategic actions to strengthen the company's market

Support management in preparing annual budgets, sales forecasts, and business growth plans.

Maintain accurate sales forecasts, opportunity tracking, and customer records in the CRM/ERP system.

Conduct regular pipeline reviews and report order intake forecasts, probability of conversion, expected order

timing, and major business risks.

Track quotations, customer feedback, order conversion rates, and sales performance against targets.

Prepare monthly and quarterly sales reports for management. Ensure systematic follow-up of all active RFQs.

G. Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Coordination

Lead, guide, and develop the sales and business development team. Define individual sales targets and

performance objectives.

Coach team members on technical sales, customer engagement, negotiation, and opportunity management.

Coordinate with engineering, project management, procurement, production, and finance teams to ensure

alignment between customer commitments and execution capabilities.

Represent the company at customer meetings, industry events, exhibitions, and business development forums.

**3. EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline.

MBA in Sales, Marketing, or Business Management will be an added advantage.

10-15 years of experience in industrial automation sales, technical sales, or business development.

At least 3-5 years of experience in a sales leadership or business development management role is preferred.

Proven experience in selling customized automation equipment, assembly lines, SPMs, robotic systems, or testing

equipment.

Established relationships with automotive OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers, or industrial manufacturing customers will be an

advantage.

**4. KEY SKILLS & COMPETENCIES**

Strong technical understanding of industrial automation and manufacturing processes.

Excellent business development, networking, and strategic account management skills.

Strong commercial negotiation, pricing, costing, and contract management capabilities.

Ability to understand technical RFQs and coordinate the development of competitive solutions.

Proficiency in MS Office, CRM, and ERP systems. Willingness to travel extensively as required.

Order Intake & Pipeline: Achievement of annual order booking targets and maintenance of a qualified sales

Conversion & Profitability: Improvement in quotation-to-order conversion rate and achievement of targeted

gross margins.

customers.

title: Fleet Supply Executive - Pune
description:
**Fleet Supply Executive**

**Location:**
Pune

**Department:**
Fleet Ops. - Supply

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Fleet Supply Executive to drive the acquisition, onboarding, activation and ongoing

management of delivery partners across assigned locations. The role will focus on building a strong and reliable delivery partner fleet by identifying area-wise supply requirements, sourcing new partners, managing the onboarding funnel, improving activation and retaining existing partners. The executive will work closely with field recruiters and internal teams to ensure a consistent pipeline of delivery partners and healthy fleet availability across key areas.

The ideal candidate should be proactive, target-oriented and comfortable managing field teams and engaging with delivery partners in a fast-paced environment.

**1. Fleet Acquisition & Sourcing**

* Drive delivery partner acquisition to meet location-wise and area-wise fleet requirements.
* Identify high-potential sourcing locations, rider catchment areas and relevant acquisition channels.
* Build and maintain a consistent pipeline of prospective delivery partners through field sourcing, referrals, local networks and other channels.
* Plan and execute on-ground acquisition activities to generate qualified partner leads.
* Set daily and weekly acquisition targets and ensure consistent progress against them.
* Track lead generation, follow-ups, conversion and joining performance to improve acquisition efficiency.

**2. Onboarding & Activation**

* Own the delivery partner onboarding journey from initial enquiry through registration, verification and activation.
* Coordinate with onboarding and verification teams to ensure timely completion of partner documentation and formalities.
* Drive newly onboarded partners to complete their first order and become active on the platform.
* Monitor the onboarding funnel and identify reasons for partner drop-offs at each stage.
* Follow up with pending and partially onboarded partners to improve conversion and activation rates.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, onboarding status, activation and first-order completion.

**3. Existing Fleet Management, Engagement & Retention**

* Manage and build relationships with the existing delivery partner fleet across assigned areas.
* Track partner activity levels and identify inactive, low-activity and at-risk partners.
* Drive partner reactivation initiatives to bring inactive partners back onto the platform.
* Conduct regular partner interactions and field visits to understand concerns, expectations and reasons for inactivity.
* Communicate partner earning opportunities, incentive programmes, referral schemes and relevant policy updates.
* Develop engagement initiatives that improve partner participation, satisfaction and long-term retention.
* Identify recurring reasons for partner churn and recommend initiatives to improve fleet stability.

**4. Field Team & Recruitment Management**

* Coordinate and manage field recruiters or acquisition executives to achieve assigned fleet acquisition targets.
* Allocate sourcing areas and daily activity plans to the field acquisition team.
* Monitor individual team performance across lead generation, partner onboarding and activation.
* Conduct regular reviews, provide guidance and support the team in improving conversion and productivity.
* Ensure field team members maintain accurate lead and partner acquisition trackers.
* Identify hiring or sourcing capacity gaps and escalate requirements to the relevant team.

**5. Area-wise Fleet Planning & Supply Growth**

* Understand area-wise fleet requirements and identify locations where additional delivery partners need to be acquired.
* Maintain visibility of active, inactive and newly onboarded partners across assigned areas.
* Prioritise acquisition efforts based on identified supply gaps, partner availability and business growth requirements.
* Recommend local sourcing strategies to strengthen fleet coverage in priority areas.
* Work with internal stakeholders to align acquisition plans with changing supply requirements.

**6. Reporting & Performance Tracking**

* Maintain daily and weekly trackers covering leads generated, partners onboarded, activated and retained.
* Prepare regular updates on acquisition pipeline, conversion rates, activation performance and field team
* productivity.
* Track key performance indicators and take corrective action where targets are not being achieved.
* Highlight sourcing challenges, onboarding bottlenecks and partner churn trends with supporting data.
* Share progress against assigned acquisition and fleet growth targets with the reporting manager.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Strong communication, interpersonal and relationship-management skills.
* Ability to acquire, onboard and engage delivery partners at scale.
* Experience in field recruitment, lead generation and target-driven sourcing.
* Strong team coordination and the ability to manage field acquisition teams.
* Good understanding of delivery partner behavior, fleet supply and last-mile delivery ecosystems.
* Strong follow-up, negotiation and problem-solving skills.
* Working knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets and basic performance trackers.
* Self-driven, organized and comfortable working towards daily and monthly targets.
* Willingness to travel locally for field visits and partner acquisition activities.

**Preferred Experience**

* 1–3 years of experience in fleet acquisition, delivery partner onboarding, field recruitment, logistics, e-commerce, food delivery, quick commerce or similar sectors.
* Experience working with delivery partners, riders, drivers, field recruiters or on-ground acquisition teams.
* Prior experience in managing sourcing targets, onboarding funnels or partner engagement initiatives will be preferred.
* Freshers with strong communication skills and an aptitude for field acquisition may also be considered.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* New delivery partner leads generated against assigned targets.
* New delivery partner acquisition and joining rate.
* Onboarding completion and verification rate.
* New partner activation and first-order completion rate.
* Onboarding funnel conversion and drop-off rate.
* Active fleet growth across assigned areas.
* Existing partner retention and reactivation rate.
* Reduction in partner inactivity and churn.
* Field recruiter productivity and target achievement.
* Area-wise fleet supply gap closure.

title: Client Relationship Manager

The role acts as the primary point of contact for clients, ensuring seamless communication and proactive issue resolution across internal teams. The Client Relationship Manager also plays a key role in driving client retention, enhancing overall centre experience, and identifying opportunities for upselling and relationship growth.

* Act as the primary point of contact for all clients and co-workers at assigned centres.

* Ensure completion of client handover documents and obtain all required internal and client sign-offs.
* Manage client exits, including documentation, asset handover, and coordination with internal stakeholders.
* Handle client escalations and manage the ticketing process, ensuring timely resolution and regular communication with clients.
* Conduct quarterly client feedback / CSAT reviews, share insights with internal stakeholders, and drive improvement actions.

* Conflict resolution and escalation handling

* Event planning and execution capability
* Sales orientation with service mindset

* Be an advocate of our BeyondZero culture and company values.
* Lead compliance with our Corporate Identity Program and client confidentiality requirements for all sales documents relating to the opportunity/proposals.

* Analyse client requests & develop response plan (B&P budget, response team, compliance checklist, writing plan, response outline, schedule).

title: Reservations Associate (Hospitality)
description:
**US Shift Timings : 4PM - 2AM**

**Location - Pune (Yerwada)**

**Work From Office (Mon - Fri)**

**Job Description: Reservations Associate**

**About Us:**

Atica is a leading, tech-first remote sales & revenue management company for Hotels and Hotel operators in the US, enabled by a unified tech-led solution. We are a startup, funded by the top investors in the country, like Titan Capital, DIBS. As innovators at the forefront of the industry, we strive to deliver the highest quality service to all our clients while setting new standards for efficiency and effectiveness. We aspire to build high-quality, innovative & robust software that makes an impact!

**Find more about us!**

https://www.aticaglobal.com

https://www.linkedin.com/company/atica-global

**Role Purpose**

The Reservations Manager at Atica acts as the virtual reservations hub for multiple US hotel clients simultaneously. You are responsible for maximizing revenue captured from every incoming reservation inquiry — through calls, emails, OTA platforms, and direct website bookings — while ensuring seamless reservation operations for the hotel's front desk and management team.

This is not a passive, reactive role. You will proactively identify upsell opportunities, ensure rate parity across all booking channels, manage group and corporate reservation blocks, and be the first point of escalation for reservation-related client concerns. Your work directly feeds into the hotel's RevPAR, ADR, and occupancy numbers — the metrics Atica is hired to move.

Because hotel clients are on month-to-month contracts with 30-day exit clauses, the Reservations Manager must deliver consistent, visible value every single month.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Reservations Operations & Conversion

\* Handle all incoming reservation inquiries across channels: phone, email, OTA platforms (Booking.com, Expedia, Hotels.com, Agoda, etc.), and the hotel's direct booking website.

\* Convert every qualified inquiry into a confirmed reservation — maximizing conversion rate while upselling room types, packages, and add-ons where applicable.

\* Respond to all reservation queries promptly (within SLA) to minimize lead leakage and lost revenue.

\* Manage waitlists, room-type availability, and booking modifications or cancellations professionally and accurately.

\* Ensure all reservations are entered correctly into the Property Management System (PMS) with complete guest details, rate codes, and special requests.

**2. Rate Management & Channel Parity**

\* Monitor and maintain rate parity across all OTA channels and the hotel's direct booking website — no undercutting, no discrepancies.

\* Work in close coordination with the Revenue Manager to implement rate strategies and ensure the right rates are loaded and live across all channels at all times.

\* Identify and flag rate loading errors, missing promotions, or channel-level discrepancies that could cause revenue leakage.

\* Update seasonal rates, promotional packages, and special offers across channels as directed by the Revenue Manager.

**3. Corporate & Group Reservations**

\* Manage all corporate account reservations — ensuring contracted rates are correctly applied, rooming lists are accurate, and billing instructions are set up correctly.

\* Handle group booking blocks: cut-off dates, pickup tracking, attrition management, and coordination with the hotel's front desk for arrival readiness.

\* Respond to group RFP inquiries and coordinate with the Sales Manager on quotes, contracts, and follow-ups for group business conversion.

\* Liaise with in-house guests and corporate bookers to identify opportunities for extended stays or recurring negotiated business.

**4. OTA & Distribution Channel Management**

\* Ensure accurate hotel listing content on all OTA platforms: room descriptions, photos, amenity listings, policies, and content scores.

\* Monitor OTA dashboards for booking trends, cancellation rates, and competitor positioning — flagging insights to the Revenue Manager.

\* Manage allotments and stop-sell/open-sell decisions in real time based on occupancy levels and Revenue Manager guidance.

\* Support the launch and optimization of the hotel on new distribution channels (wholesalers, meta-search, B2B platforms) as Atica expands the hotel's distribution footprint.

**5. Client Communication & Relationship Management**

\* Act as the day-to-day reservations point of contact for assigned hotel clients — responding professionally and promptly to all reservation-related queries.

\* Build strong working relationships with hotel GMs and front desk teams to ensure smooth coordination between Atica's remote reservations function and on-property operations.

\* Provide weekly and monthly reservations performance summaries to hotel clients: bookings by channel, ADR, cancellations, and pick-up trends.

\* Navigate cultural nuances when communicating with US-based clients — professional, confident, and clear at all times.

**6. Ancillary Reservations Support**

\* OTA Reconciliation: Review monthly OTA invoices and flag any erroneous charges or commission discrepancies for resolution.

\* OTA Revenue Recovery: Track and charge Virtual Credit Cards (VCCs) from past bookings to ensure all realized revenue is collected.

\* Reputation Management Support: Flag guest concerns surfaced during reservation interactions that may impact online reviews; coordinate with the team on service recovery.

\* Direct.com Bookings: Support the hotel's direct website bookings by responding to queries, applying promotions, and tracking booking engine performance.

**Who We Are Looking For**

**Must-Have Qualifications**

\* 0–3 years of experience in hotel reservations, front office operations, or a related hospitality role.

\* Strong working knowledge of OTA platforms (Booking.com, Expedia, Agoda, Hotels.com) — listing management, extranets, and rate loading.

\* Hands-on experience with a Property Management System (PMS) — Opera, Cloudbeds, Mews, or similar.

\* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills — you will interact with US-based hotel clients and guests daily.

\* High attention to detail: rate codes, rooming lists, billing instructions, and reservation accuracy are non-negotiable.

\* Ability to multitask across multiple hotel accounts simultaneously without compromising quality.

\* Comfortable working the 7 PM – 5 AM IST shift to align with US business hours.

\* Working on weekends as per requirement

\* Work-from-office commitment at our India headquarters.

**Good-to-Have**

\* Experience with Revenue Management Systems (RMS) — understanding how rates and inventory are managed in real time.

\* Familiarity with branded hotel systems — Marriott, Hilton, IHG, Wyndham, or Choice Hotels platforms and standards.

\* Prior experience handling corporate RFPs, group blocks, or negotiated rate contracts.

\* Understanding of B2B distribution channels — wholesalers (HotelBeds, WebBeds), travel management companies, or GDS.

\* Startup mindset: adaptable, proactive, and comfortable building processes in an evolving environment.

**Why Join Us**

Build a vertical from scratch—not just manage one.

Competitive salary + performance-linked bonus.

CTC aligned with experience & market benchmarks.

Direct exposure to demand partners, US hotel stakeholders, and senior leadership.

Clear career growth path in Distribution & Operations leadership

* Experience supporting healthcare professionals in hospital, operating room, or catheterization laboratory settings.
* Knowledge of cardiovascular therapies, clinical workflows, and healthcare stakeholder engagement.

* Proven record of exceeding sales objectives in medical device or healthcare industries.
* Experience managing distributor networks and channel partnerships.

title: Dental Consultant (International Tele-consultation)
description:
**About the Role:**

We are looking for a dentist who is as comfortable on a video call as they are in the chair. In this role, you will run teleconsultations with international patients, review their dental records, X-rays, and treatment goals, and give them a clear clinical opinion. You will then guide them through the treatment plan, the estimated cost, and the partner clinic we recommend, so they can make a confident decision.

This is a clinically credible, patient-facing role with a consultative sales element. If you enjoy explaining treatment options, building trust quickly and helping people say yes to the right plan, you will do well here.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct video teleconsultations with international patients seeking dental treatment abroad (implants, full-mouth rehabilitation, veneers, crowns, smile makeovers, orthodontics, root canals, and more).
* Review patient-submitted OPGs, X-rays, photos, and dental history, and assess case complexity.
* Draft a preliminary treatment plan and explain it in plain, reassuring language.
* Present estimated pricing, treatment packages and the recommended partner hospital or clinic, explaining why it suits the patient's case, budget and travel plans.
* Handle patient questions and objections on cost, quality, safety, travel, duration of stay and aftercare, honestly and without pressure.
* Follow up with undecided patients and help move them towards a confirmed booking.
* Coordinate with partner clinics on case feasibility, treatment timelines, and pricing queries.
* Work closely with our patient coordination and sales teams to ensure a smooth handover after consultation.
* Document every consultation accurately in our in-house CRM.
* Maintain high standards of clinical ethics, patient confidentiality, and data privacy at all times.
* Share feedback on common patient concerns and case patterns to help us improve our process and content.

**Who You Are:**

* Must haveBDS (MDS is a plus) with a valid dental registration in India.
* Years of clinical experience in general or multi-specialty dentistry (to confirm).
* Strong command of English, spoken and written, with a clear, warm, and confident communication style.
* Comfort with video consultations and with explaining clinical concepts to non-clinical people.
* Willingness to discuss pricing and recommend a clinic as part of the consultation. You see this as part of helping the patient, not as a distraction from medicine.
* Strong working knowledge of restorative, implant, and cosmetic dentistry.
* Ability to work flexible hours to match patient time zones (US, UK, Australia, GCC and Europe).

**Good to have**

* Prior experience in teleconsultations, patient counseling, or treatment-plan sales at a dental chain or clinic.
* Experience with international patients or dental tourism.
* Additional languages (Arabic, German, or others).
* Familiarity with CRM tools and structured consultation workflows.

**What Makes You Great in This Role:**

* You build trust within the first five minutes of a call.
* You are persuasive and never pushy. Patients leave the call feeling informed, not sold to.
* You are calm with anxious patients and patient with detailed questions.
* You are comfortable with targets and take ownership of conversion outcomes.
* You are organized and quick to follow up.

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
**Role:**
Regional Sales Manager

**Locations:**
Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Surat, Bhopal, Jaipur

**Work mode:**
Field-based, mostly at client sites in your territory

**Reports to:**
Zonal Leader

**Team:**
5 Sales Executives report to you

**Working days:**
6 days (Sunday off)

**Contract duration:**
12 months (Extendable)

**About the Role**

Our client records skilled manual work with lightweight wearable cameras at partner businesses (factories, hospitals, hotels, workshops, and shops), and pays those businesses for every hour recorded. This footage is used to train robotics and physical AI.

As a Regional Sales Manager, you will own one territory in your city, lead a team of 5 Sales Executives, and personally sign the largest businesses in your area.

What You Will Do

**Sell to large businesses**

* Win large and mid-sized partners (factories, hospitals, hotels, labs) by meeting owners, plant heads, and administrators.
* Pitch the business value: productivity insights, workstation safety analysis, and a route into automation programmes.
* Work longer sales cycles: repeat visits, safety and site approvals, and getting the decision-maker to say yes.
* Stay the main point of contact for every business you sign, through recording and payments.

**Lead your team**

* Hire, train, and lead 5 Sales Executives who sign small shops and workshops across your territory.
* Run a short daily team meeting and a weekly review against targets.
* Split your territory so no two people on your team approach the same business.
* Make sure every business your team signs is genuine and recorded correctly in our app.

**Report and improve**

* Share weekly numbers with your Zonal Leader: businesses signed, hours recorded, and gaps by business type.
* Flag what is working and what isn't in the pitch, pricing, or process.

**Who We Are Looking For**

**Must have**

* 5–8 years in B2B field sales.
* At least 1–2 years leading a field sales team of 4 or more people.
* A track record of closing deals that needed sign-off from an owner, plant head, or senior administrator.
* Comfort on the shop floor: shifts, supervisors, contract labour, safety audits.
* Fluency in the local language of your city, plus English.
* Your own two-wheeler or car, and willingness to be in the field most days.

**Good to have**

* Experience in industrial automation, machinery or tools, safety equipment, industrial chemicals, facility management, or hospital and lab equipment.
* Existing relationships with industrial associations or business owners in your city.

5–10 Years (Relevant IT Services Sales)

**About the Role :**

Senwell Group is looking for a highly driven and experienced
**Business Development Manager (BDM)**
with a proven track record of acquiring international IT projects for software development and technology services companies.

The ideal candidate must have strong knowledge of international IT markets, excellent client acquisition capabilities, and hands-on experience in winning small, medium, and large software development projects.

We are looking for a
**revenue-generating business development professional**
, not merely a lead generation specialist.

The candidate will be responsible for building international business relationships, identifying outsourcing opportunities, winning direct client contracts, and driving revenue growth for the organization.

**key Responsibilities**

**1. Internation Business Development**

* Identify and acquire new clients across the USA, UK, Europe, Canada, Australia, and other international markets.
* Generate qualified business opportunities through outbound prospecting, networking, referrals, digital channels, and strategic partnerships.
* Develop relationships with CTOs, CIOs, CEOs, founders, IT directors, procurement heads, and technology decision-makers.
* Establish long-term relationships with international companies seeking reliable offshore development and IT service partners.
* Independently manage the sales lifecycle from initial prospecting to final contract closure.

**2. IT ProjectAcquisition**

Acquire projects in the following areas:

**Custom Software & Application Development**

* Enterprise application development
* Web and mobile application development
* SaaS product development
* ERP and CRM solutions
* Cloud-native applications
* API development and third-party integrations
* Application modernization and migration
* AI-enabled applications and automation solutions

**IT Services & Outsourcing**

* Dedicated development teams
* Staff augmentation and resource outsourcing
* Offshore development centers (ODC)
* Application maintenance and support
* QA and software testing services
* Cloud engineering and DevOps
* Managed application services
* Long-term technology support and development contracts

The candidate should be comfortable pursuing projects ranging from small development assignments to large, multi-year enterprise engagements.

**3. Lead Generation & Sales Conversion**

* Build and maintain a strong international sales pipeline.
* Execute outbound sales strategies through LinkedIn, professional networking, cold emails, discovery calls, and partner networks.
* Utilize platforms such as Clutch, GoodFirms, Upwork, and relevant B2B business directories where commercially appropriate.
* Identify outsourcing requirements, active development projects, vendor onboarding opportunities, and RFPs/RFQs.
* Conduct client discovery meetings and understand business and technical requirements.
* Coordinate with technical teams to prepare proposals, estimates, presentations, and statements of work.
* Convert qualified opportunities into signed contracts and active projects.

**4. Strategic Account Management**

* Develop long-term relationships with international clients.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business, cross-selling, and upselling.
* Expand small initial engagements into larger development projects and recurring contracts.
* Build partnerships with international consulting firms, software companies, and technology service providers.
* Support existing accounts in identifying additional development and service opportunities.

**5. Commercial Negotiation & Revenue Ownership**

* Independently handle commercial discussions, pricing negotiations, and contract closures.
* Understand fixed-price, time-and-material (T&M), dedicated resource, retainer, and managed service engagement models.
* Coordinate on MSAs, NDAs, SOWs, and client onboarding requirements.
* Maintain accurate sales forecasting, pipeline reporting, and revenue projections.

Take ownership of assigned business acquisition and revenue targets.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in international IT services business development.
* Proven experience in acquiring international custom software development projects.
* Strong understanding of the USA and European IT outsourcing markets.
* Demonstrated history of winning business directly for an IT services company.
* Experience selling both project-based software development and ongoing IT services.
* Ability to communicate confidently with international technical and business stakeholders.
* Excellent English communication, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.
* Strong understanding of software development technologies, delivery models, and outsourcing structures.
* Experience handling multiple deal sizes and complex sales cycles.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

Candidates will be given preference if they have:

* Successfully acquired direct software development projects from US or European companies.
* Existing professional relationships with international decision-makers.
* Previous experience working with a mid-sized Indian IT services or software outsourcing organization.
* Experience converting initial small engagements into long-term accounts.
* A strong track record in closing deals without depending entirely on inbound leads.
* Experience building international sales channels and partnerships from scratch.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be measured against:

1. Qualified international sales opportunities generated.
2. New client acquisition and signed contracts.
3. Monthly and quarterly project booking value.
4. Actual business revenue generated.
5. Conversion rate from qualified leads to signed deals.
6. Repeat business and long-term account development.
7. Growth of international client accounts.

**Important:**
The primary success measure for this position is actual business acquisition and revenue generation, not simply the volume of emails, meetings, or leads.

**What We Are Looking For**

We need a business development professional who can:

**Find international opportunities → Engage decision-makers → Understand project requirements → Coordinate technical proposals → Negotiate commercials → Close contracts → Generate recurring business.**

The selected candidate should be capable of establishing Senwell Group as a trusted technology development and IT services partner for global clients.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Pixation Studios is a specialized content creation agency dedicated to the interior design and architecture industry. The team combines creative storytelling, professional photography, videography, and social media strategy to help design brands communicate their vision and build a strong online presence. Services include interior photography and videography, social media content creation, reels and short-form video production, and social media strategy and management. Pixation Studios focuses on showcasing completed projects, behind-the-scenes moments, and design insights to keep client brands relevant and visible. The company aims to be a long-term content partner, supporting clients in building a consistent digital presence while they focus on designing exceptional spaces.

**Role Description**
The Business Development Manager role at Pixation Studios is a part-time remote position focused on growing the client base within the interior design and architecture sectors. Day-to-day responsibilities include identifying and qualifying potential clients, conducting outreach via email, social media, and virtual meetings, and presenting Pixation’s services in a clear, compelling way. The role involves nurturing relationships with design and architecture firms, collaborating with the internal team to align service offerings with client needs, and contributing to proposals and pricing discussions. The Business Development Manager will track leads, maintain a structured sales pipeline, provide regular performance updates, and suggest strategies to expand Pixation’s presence in target markets.

**Qualifications**

* Business development and sales skills, including lead generation, prospecting, and pipeline management.
* Client relationship management and account management skills, with the ability to build trust and maintain long-term partnerships.
* Strong communication and presentation abilities, including confident virtual meeting skills and clear written communication.
* Understanding of marketing and social media in a B2B context, especially within creative or design-focused industries.
* Ability to work independently in a remote setting, manage time effectively, and meet targets with minimal supervision.
* Experience working with or selling services to interior designers, architects, or creative agencies is highly beneficial.
* Familiarity with CRM tools or structured tracking of leads and client interactions.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Part-Time Business Development Representative (B2B)
description:
**Company Description**
MS Ledger Solutions provides professional accounting and bookkeeping services to small and mid-sized businesses, CPA firms, and growing organizations. With more than 16 years of experience, the company specializes in full-cycle bookkeeping, AP/AR, reconciliations, invoicing, payroll support, month-end close, financial reporting, general ledger review, and historical bookkeeping cleanup. The team works with QuickBooks Online, QuickBooks Desktop, and Xero, serving clients across real estate, property management, staffing, consulting, professional services, e-commerce, restaurants, manufacturing, and other sectors. MS Ledger Solutions focuses on accurate books, clear communication, dependable service, and practical accounting support that helps clients stay organized and grow.

We are looking for a motivated and relationship-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to help expand our business, generate qualified leads, and build strong relationships with potential clients and referral partners.

The ideal candidate enjoys networking, connecting with business owners, identifying business opportunities, and developing long-term professional relationships.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and connect with potential clients, including business owners, entrepreneurs, and small to mid-sized businesses.
* Conduct B2B outreach through LinkedIn, email, phone calls, and other networking channels.
* Build and maintain relationships with CPA firms, tax professionals, accounting firms, and other potential referral partners.
* Research target markets and identify qualified prospects.
* Introduce our services and communicate our value proposition to potential clients.
* Generate qualified leads and schedule consultation calls.
* Maintain a database of prospects, track outreach activities, and manage follow-ups.
* Develop and execute strategies to expand our referral network and generate new business opportunities.

Requirements & Qualifications

* Previous experience in B2B business development, lead generation, sales, or networking.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills.
* Comfortable reaching out to business owners, CPA firms, tax professionals, and decision-makers.
* Experience with LinkedIn outreach, cold emailing, and prospect research.
* Ability to identify potential opportunities and convert prospects into qualified leads.
* Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently.
* Strong organizational skills and consistent follow-up habits.

Engagement Details

* Position: Part-Time Business Development Representative
* Engagement: Flexible / Remote
* Working Hours: Part-time, flexible schedule
* Compensation: Open to discussion based on experience and proposed engagement structure.
* Growth Opportunity: Potential to transition into a broader business development and sales role as the business expands.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the lead generation process, build meaningful business relationships, and consistently create new opportunities.

Initially, the focus will be on generating qualified leads and scheduling consultations. Business consultations and closing will be handled internally. As the business grows, there will be an opportunity to take on greater responsibility for the overall sales process.

How to Apply

If you have experience in B2B business development, enjoy building professional networks, and are confident in generating new business opportunities, we would love to hear from you.

Please share your experience, relevant industry exposure, and examples of successful lead generation or business development initiatives.

**Company Description**
Conservit Power Solutions is a fast-growing clean energy solutions provider and authorized channel partner for Tata Power Renewable Energy & Tata Power EZ Charge. We deliver end-to-end turnkey solutions across Rooftop Solar (Residential & Commercial/Industrial), EV Charging Infrastructure, and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) across Pune, PCMC, and Western Maharashtra.

**Role Description**
We are looking for an energetic, results-driven Business Development Manager with 1–2 years of hands-on field sales experience. In this role, you will be the primary face of Conservit for inbound leads, commercial clients, residential societies, and industrial facility owners. You will drive qualified leads from initial consultation to on-site meetings, technical proposal presentations, and final contract closure.

* Lead Engagement & Qualification: Promptly attend to verified inbound leads from digital campaigns, website enquiries, and direct calls.
* In-Person Client Meetings: Conduct face-to-face consultations with homeowners, housing society committees (CHSs), factory owners, and commercial fleet managers across Pune and PCMC.

* Client Relationship Building: Cultivate long-term rapport with decision-makers, architects, electrical consultants, and facility heads to generate repeat and referral business.
* Pipeline & Follow-ups: Maintain structured follow-up cadences via phone, email, and in-person visits to move proposals through negotiation and agreement signing.

* Strong business development, sales, and account management skills, with the ability to build long-term client relationships and manage a structured pipeline.
* Capability in market analysis, opportunity identification, and strategic planning to expand presence in commercial, industrial, and residential segments.

* High-Growth Industry: Direct exposure to the booming renewable energy and EV infrastructure sectors backed by top-tier brand partnerships (Tata Power).
* Fast Career Progression: Ample room for leadership growth as Conservit expands across Western Maharashtra.

title: Services Sales Executive-IT Service
description:
**SERVICES SALES EXECUTIVE — INDIA**

Software Development & Managed Engineering · 12th Wonder · Pune

12th Wonder has delivered custom software and managed engineering teams to 100+ Indian enterprises since 2012. The delivery engine is proven — 70 engineers, a Pune centre operational since 2019, and a client base that renews.

What's missing is a dedicated hunter who can systematically connect this capability to new buyers. We're hiring a Services Sales Executive to own a territory, build pipeline from scratch, and close new-logo deals across India.

**THE ROLE**

This is a pure selling role. No team to manage in year one. No SDR motion to build. Your job is to find enterprise buyers who need custom software development or managed engineering capacity, and close them.

**You'll spend 80%+ of your time in front of customers**
— identifying strategic accounts, building relationships with CXOs and engineering leaders, running discovery, shaping solutions with our pre-sales and delivery teams, writing proposals, negotiating contracts, and closing. The remaining time goes into pipeline hygiene, forecasting, and sharpening your territory plan.

**You own your territory and your number.**
You'll define target accounts within assigned segments, decide your outbound approach, and run your own pipeline cadence. You'll have a pre-sales engineer and delivery leadership behind you on every qualified opportunity — but the deal is yours to win or lose.

**Your buyer:**
India-domiciled enterprises across three primary segments — automotive OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers, testing and certification (TIC) labs, and enterprise engineering R&D centres. Rupee-denominated, relationship-led, CXO-level deals averaging ~₹20 lakh. Pune's position inside the Chakan–Talegaon supplier belt puts the densest cluster of target accounts within a morning's drive.

**WHAT YOU'RE SELLING**

Two proven service lines, both with referenceable customers and repeatable delivery models:

**Custom software development.**
Full-stack engineering teams that design, build, and ship applications for enterprise clients — web, mobile, cloud, data, and integration. Engagements typically start as fixed-scope projects and expand into ongoing development partnerships.

**Managed engineering teams.**
Dedicated engineering capacity operated from our Pune centre, embedded in the client's product or platform roadmap. Longer-duration, higher-ACV engagements with sticky renewal economics. Clients retain technical control; we provide the team, the management layer, and the delivery infrastructure.

Both service lines sell to the same buyers through the same motion. The typical land is a ₹15–25 lakh project engagement; the expand is a managed team at 3–5x the initial contract value

**MILESTONES**

***Exhibit 1: Year-one de***

**First 30 days**

Territory plan defined. Target account list of 50+ accounts built and prioritised. CRM configured. First outbound sequences live.

**First 60 days**

Minimum 15 first meetings completed. At least 5 qualified opportunities in pipeline with identified budget and decision-maker.

﻿First 90 days

Pipeline value at 2x forward target. First proposals submitted. At least one deal in advanced negotiation

**First 180 days**

First closed-won deals on the board. Pipeline coverage at 3x forward target. Clear expansion path identified in at least two landed accounts

**End of year one**

₹75 lakh in closed revenue — roughly four deals at our average size. At least one account in active expansion from project to managed team.

**COMPENSATION**

Cash role — fixed plus variable, no ESOP attached. We'd rather be transparent about the economics than quote an OTE and let you reverse-engineer it.

***Exhibit 2: Compensation structure***

Fixed ₹12–15L

Target ₹75 lakh

Variable Plan ₹5.6L

OTE AT Plan ₹18–21L

**FIXARGE**
**VARIABLE AT PLA**
**OTE AT PLA**

**Variable is a flat 7.5% of closed revenue, uncapped.**
The rate doesn't taper past target — close ₹1 crore and the plan pays ₹7.5L variable, no renegotiation. Variable pays pro-rata from 70% of target, on revenue closed at or above floor margin. We're not going to pay you to discount, and you shouldn't want a plan that does.

**DETAILS**

***Exhibit 3: Role parameters***

**Location**

Pune. Remote (India) considered for strong candidates, with monthly onsite weeks.

**Buyer geography**

India-domiciled enterprises

**Reports to**

Chief Operating Officer

**Year-one target**

₹75 lakh in closed revenue

**Typical deal size**

~₹20 lakh

**Travel**

~30%, primarily metro India and the Pune industrial belt

**Team**

Individual contributor. Pre-sales and delivery support on qualified deals.

**Start**

Immediate

**HOW HIRING WORKS**

Three conversations over about two weeks:

**1. Screening call (30 min)**
— your track record, deal examples, and whether the buyer profile matches what you've sold.

**2. Pipeline walkthrough (60 min)**
— pick one of your best deals and walk us through it end-to-end: how you found it, how you qualified it, how you closed it, and what you'd do differently.

**3. Leadership conversation (45 min)**
— with the COO: territory, the number, and the terms.

Decision within 5 working days of the last conversation, either way.

description:

We are seeking a highly experienced Domain Solution Consultant with strong functional consulting expertise across banking, payments, and fintech ecosystems. This role is focused on domain-led solutioning, client consulting, and sales enablement, supporting go-to-market initiatives, inside sales, and pre-sales activities. The ideal candidate will bring deep financial services domain knowledge combined with the ability to craft client-specific value propositions, conduct discovery-led consulting, and articulate clear business outcomes across payments modernization, cards, open banking, and emerging digital asset use cases.

* Translate client requirements into clear functional solution constructs, business flows, and operating models.
* Client Engagement & Consulting: Conduct discovery sessions, workshops, and stakeholder discussions with banks, fintechs, and financial institutions. Understand client challenges, regulatory environments, and transformation priorities. Act as a bridge between business stakeholders, sales teams, and technology/delivery teams.

Identify high-potential client segments, use cases, and buying triggers. Create compelling campaign messaging, hooks, and value narratives.

* Solution Proposition & Pre Sales: Develop value propositions, business cases, and use-case narratives aligned to client priorities. Support RFP/RFI responses, proposals, and solution presentations. Clearly articulate business outcomes, ROI, operational impact, and strategic value.
* Solution Validation & Innovation: Guide proof-of-concepts (PoCs) and pilot initiatives from a functional and domain standpoint. Bring industry trends, regulatory insights, and competitive perspectives into client conversations. Identify opportunities for new offerings, solution accelerators, and GTM plays.

**Skills & Experience Required:**

* 4+ years of relevant experience in Banking, Financial Services, or Fintech, with exposure to consulting, solutioning, or pre-sales roles.
* Strong understanding of Payments ecosystems and messaging standards (ISO20022, ISO8583), Card platforms and end-to-end card lifecycle, Open Banking frameworks and fintech integrations, Stablecoins and digital asset use cases, Risk management, AML, and fraud controls

* Experience supporting inside sales and business development teams.

**Why Opus Technologies?**

Opus Technologies is shaping the future of Banking & Payments. With experience building highly innovative solutions and products, we combine our deep technology proficiency with unmatched domain expertise in Banking, Payments and Fintech, enabling us to deliver unparalleled quality and value in everything we do.

We’re headquartered in Alpharetta, Georgia, USA and our offshore software development center based out of Pune office in India.

It is not just a tech company - we are a digital transformation partner to some of the world’s leading financial institutions. Our teams specialize in building scalable, secure, and innovative solutions in issuing, acquiring, switching, digital wallets, and real-time payments. At Opus Technologies, we don’t just build software—we engineer solutions that transform industries. As a fast-growing digital transformation partner, Opus empowers global enterprises with cutting-edge technology across Cloud, Data, AI/ML, DevOps, and Product Engineering.

title: Lead Qualification Representative
description:
Location: Remote
  
  
Schedule: Full-time, EST Business Hours Required
  
  
**Compensation:**
C$40,000–C$50,000 annually, based on performance and qualifications
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Langford Staffing is recruiting experienced outbound calling professionals to qualify consumers and connect eligible individuals with licensed representatives through live transfers.
  
  
This is a performance-focused position for someone who can communicate confidently, think quickly, handle objections and remain professional during continuous high-volume calling.
  
  
You will not provide licensed advice or complete customer enrolments. Your responsibility is to qualify consumers, obtain their permission and complete an accurate live transfer.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Contact consumer leads using an outbound dialer.
* Follow campaign scripts, introductions and compliance requirements.
* Ask focused questions to determine whether consumers meet campaign requirements.
* Explain the reason for the call clearly and professionally.
* Handle hesitation, objections, rejection and difficult conversations.
* Obtain permission and complete warm live transfers.
* Remain on the call until the receiving representative accepts the handoff.
* Record accurate notes, dispositions, outcomes and follow-up requirements.
* Handle unsuccessful transfers and callbacks according to campaign procedures.
* Apply feedback from call reviews, coaching and performance reporting.
* Learn and work across different consumer-service campaigns.

**Required Experience**

* Three or more years of recent high-volume outbound calling experience.
* Experience qualifying leads and completing warm or live transfers.
* A history of achieving measurable call, qualification or transfer targets.
* Experience using Convoso, Five9, NICE CXone, Genesys Cloud CX, CallTools, Readymode or a comparable dialer.
* Strong understanding of call dispositions, callbacks, holds, consultation calls and live transfers.
* Experience maintainingaccurate CRM records while speaking with consumers.
* Strong listening, communication and objection-handling skills.
* Ability to remain calm and professional when dealing with rejection or abusive callers.
* Ability to type at least 35 net words per minute with strong accuracy.
* Verifiable employment history and professional references.
* Availability to work the assigned full-time campaign schedule.

Experience in insurance, health-benefit programs, telecommunications, financial services, consumer services or another regulated calling environment is an asset.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Apply with your résumé. If your background aligns with the position, you will receive an email with a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours of applying.
  
  
Selected candidates may also be asked to complete a typing test, equipment check, reference check, call role-play and live skills interview.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  
**Performance Will Be Measured Through**

* Accepted and properly qualified live transfers
* Consistent progress toward campaign production targets
* Call quality and compliance
* Accurate CRM notes and dispositions
* Productive dialer activity
* Attendance and schedule reliability
* Professional objection handling
* Improvement following coaching and call reviews

Representatives may be expected to produce approximately five accepted qualified transfers per dialing hour, depending on the campaign.
  
  
Who Will Succeed
  
  
The right person is confident, resilient, organized and comfortable speaking with a high volume of consumers every day.
  
  
You should be able to recover quickly from rejection, follow a structured process and sound natural rather than scripted. You must maintain quality while working toward demanding performance targets and remain professional when consumers become impatient, suspicious or disrespectful.
  
  
Remote Technology Requirements
  
  
**You Must Have**

* A computer with at least 16 GB of RAM
* A dual-monitor setup
* Reliable internet with a speed of at least 100 Mbps
* A backup internet connection or power solution
* A wired, noise-cancelling USB headset
* A webcam
* A quiet, private and professional workspace

title: IT Sales - Business Development Manager
description:
**About the Company**

Fineshift is a founder-led technology services company helping enterprise customers solve complex engineering challenges across DevSecOps, Monitoring & Observability, and AI.

As an independent, bootstrapped company, we prioritise customer outcomes, delivery accountability, and fast decision-making. We are authorised partners of GitLab, IBM, JFrog, Snyk, and AWS, working with large enterprises across banking, financial services, and manufacturing.

We are at a stage where the leaders we hire will shape our next phase of growth. This is an opportunity to build and scale a technology practice, not simply inherit one.

**About the role**

We are hiring
**Senior Account Executive - Enterprise Technology Sales**
who have already proven they can hunt, qualify and close enterprise technology deals and who want to own a region, not just a quota. This is a new-business role reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer, with an inside sales rep working for you.

**Locations:**
Mumbai & Pune

**What you'll do**

* Build your own pipeline in your region outbound, OEM co-selling, events and your network and own the full cycle from discovery to closure.
* Sell enterprise AI, DevSecOps and observability and monitoring services, anchored on GitLab and leading AI platforms, to CTOs, CIOs and heads of engineering.
* Carry a gross-margin quota, forecast it accurately and protect pricing and payment terms.
* Be Fineshift's face to the OEM's regional field team: deal registration, joint account plans, co-selling.
* Lead an inside sales rep who books your first meetings.

**What you bring**

* 5+ years in B2B technology sales in India, with a verifiable record of meeting quota we will ask for your last three years of numbers and reference-check them.
* You have closed enterprise or large mid-market deals of 25 lakh and above, in technology services, AI, DevOps, cloud, security, observability or data.
* You have built a territory from cold. You know what a week of outbound looks like, and you do not wait for leads.
* You can run a first meeting with a CTO on your own, and you are comfortable learning a technical product deeply.
* You understand margin, payment terms and risk, and you know when to walk away from a bad deal.
* You are proactive, accountable and results-driven: you set your own weekly targets, own your number without being chased, and measure yourself on closed business, not activity.
* You are looking for a role you can commit to and grow in for the next three to four years, not the next twelve months.

**Why Fineshift**

* **You own a region, with a path to running it.**
  Each Senior AE opens a region South, West or North. Hit your number for 4 quarters and you become the Regional Sales Manager, building the team under you. We are not hiring for a seat on a large sales floor; we are hiring the people who will lead sales as we grow.
* **Uncapped incentives on gross margin, with tiered multipliers.**
  Your earnings go up as you cross tiers, and there is no ceiling. Our top performers earn well above their fixed pay. The plan is written down and shared with you before you sign.
* **You sell what the market is buying right now.**
  Enterprise AI, DevSecOps and observability are the three budget lines growing fastest in Indian enterprises. You will be selling on top of GitLab and leading AI platforms names that open doors.
* **The OEM works your pipeline with you.**
  As one of GitLab's largest partners in India, we get partner-sourced leads, co-selling and deal registration. You are not fighting the OEM's own team for accounts.
* **A presales and delivery team that lets you promise what we deliver.**
  Demos, POCs and solutioning are handled by our in-house technology team, so you sell with confidence and hand over cleanly.
* **A short line to decisions.**
  Pricing, terms and exceptions are decided by the CRO and the founder, usually the same day. No committee, no quarter-long approval cycle.
* **A stable, bootstrapped company with no funding risk.**
  Five years in, profitable, growing, no layoffs. We grow on margin, not on burn which means your incentives get paid.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
We’re hiring SDRs. You’ll cold call US founders and operators and book meetings. We teach you everything: accent, tonality, scripts, product, objections and mindset. Freshers welcome.

**Comp and basics**

* ₹40,000/month + performance bonus
* Full-time
* On-site in Pune. You must be willing to relocate.
* Night-heavy schedule (US-aligned hours)

**About Ionio**

Ionio is the AI & Growth Arm For Founder-Led Businesses. We run go-to-market end to end for our clients: offers, messaging, cold calling, email, content and sales calls, plus the software and AI systems behind all of it. Our clients are SaaS companies and service businesses across the US and Canada. Some engagements stop at booked meetings. Others run all the way to closed deals.

The SDR team is the engine. Every engagement runs on booked meetings, and booked meetings start on the phone.

**What we’ll teach you**

You don’t need sales experience. We train you on everything a cold call takes.

* **Accent.**
  A clear, natural accent US prospects trust from the first sentence. You’ll drop the scripted call-centre sound for good.
* **Tonality.**
  How to sound calm, confident and peer-to-peer. When to slow down. When to pause. How to sound like you belong on the call.
* **Script discipline.**
  How to stick to a proven script, hit every beat and still sound human.
* **Volume.**
  How to stay sharp across a full night of dials. Rhythm, energy, focus.
* **Product knowledge.**
  What each client sells, who buys it and why. You’ll know the offer well enough to answer questions without stalling.
* **Objections and mindset.**
  You’ll hear a lot of objections and a lot of “no.” We teach you how to handle each one live, and how to stay steady on a bad night.

Training runs alongside live calling: daily roleplays, recorded call reviews and script sessions with the founder.

**What you’ll walk away with**

* A skill most people never build: getting a stranger to say yes on the phone
* The full B2B sales process from the inside: prospecting, calling, objection handling, discovery, closing, deal structure
* Experience selling different offers into different markets
* Direct coaching from the founder on every part of your calls
* A path into senior sales, account ownership or growth roles if you perform

Most people learn to sell ten years into their career. Here you learn from week one, with real prospects and real money on the line. If you ever plan to start a company, go into consulting or work in VC, you’ll use this every week for the rest of your life.

**The honest pitch**

This is a cold calling job. Most of your hours go to the phone. Dial, talk, follow up, dial again. It’s repetitive. People will hang up on you. You’ll hear “no” far more than “yes.” Your scoreboard is simple: qualified meetings booked on the calendar.

Email and LinkedIn are follow-up channels. The phone comes first. This is an execution role, and it rewards people who show up every night and do the work.

**What you’ll do**

* Cold call US founders and operators. Every shift. This is the core of the job.
* Research each prospect well enough to open a real conversation in the first ten seconds
* Handle objections live and push for the meeting
* Follow up by email and LinkedIn after calls
* Log every dial, conversation and booking so we can see what’s working
* Review your recordings with the founder and tighten your script every week
* Hit your daily dial target and weekly booked-meeting target

**Who you are**

* Fluent in spoken and written English. We’ll train the accent. The fluency has to be there already.
* Comfortable talking to strangers. Conversations give you energy.
* Resilient. Your last call of the night sounds as good as your first.
* Coachable. You take direct feedback and apply it on the next shift.
* Disciplined. You hit the numbers, then do it again the next night.
* Curious about business. You want to know how companies make money and why people buy.
* Available for nights. Core hours are roughly 11pm to 2/3am IST for US prospects. EU and Asia prospects get worked earlier, so the schedule can shift week to week.
* Willing to relocate to Pune within two months of joining
* Set up for the remote phase: your own laptop, stable internet and a quiet place to take calls

**Bonus points**

* Any calling experience: inside sales, telesales, customer calls, fundraising
* Background in SaaS, B2B sales, ecommerce or marketing
* Has used Apollo, a power dialer, Loom or Notion
* Has sold something, run outbound for your own project, or led sponsorship for a college fest

**Hiring process**

1. **Apply.**
   Email hr@ionio.io with “SDR Pune” in the subject line. Attach your CV and a 60-second voice note introducing yourself. You can also DM me here.
2. **Phone screen.**
   A short call with us.
3. **Mock call assignment.**
   We send you a short brief on one of our offers and a prospect profile. You prepare, then run live mock cold calls with us playing the prospect. We’re watching how you open, how you handle pushback and whether you ask for the meeting. Nobody expects perfect. We’re hiring for how fast you learn.
4. **Final conversation**
   with the founder.

If you want to learn sales properly, with real reps and real coaching, apply.

description:
Sales Manager – Industrial Projects & Engineering Services

**Location:**
Pune, India

About Beck & Pollitzer

Beck & Pollitzer is a global leader in industrial machinery installation, relocation, and engineering services, with over 160 years of experience delivering complex industrial projects worldwide.

We support leading manufacturers across a wide range of industries, providing end-to-end solutions for machinery installation, factory relocation, and industrial engineering projects.

Our success is built on technical expertise, a strong commitment to safety and quality, and the dedication of our people. With operations across multiple countries, we combine global capabilities with local knowledge to deliver innovative and reliable solutions to our customers.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven
**Sales Manager**
to join our team in Pune, India.

In this role, you will be responsible for driving business growth by identifying new opportunities, developing strong customer relationships, and securing industrial engineering, machinery installation, and factory relocation projects.

You will manage the full B2B sales cycle, from prospecting and technical discussions to proposal development, commercial negotiations, and contract closure.

The ideal candidate will combine strong business development skills with a solid technical understanding of industrial projects and engineering services.

Key Responsibilities

**Business Development & Sales Growth**

* Identify and develop new business opportunities across manufacturing, automotive, FMCG, infrastructure, and heavy engineering sectors.
* Promote our industrial relocation, machinery installation, and turnkey engineering services to potential customers.
* Identify greenfield and brownfield investment projects, including international manufacturers establishing or expanding operations in India.
* Achieve assigned sales targets, order bookings, and revenue objectives while maintaining profitability.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified business opportunities.

**Technical Sales & Proposal Management**

* Understand customer technical requirements and work closely with engineering and estimation teams to develop tailored solutions.
* Coordinate the preparation of competitive technical and commercial proposals for industrial projects.
* Manage RFQs, RFPs, and tender submissions, ensuring timely and accurate responses.
* Participate in technical discussions, site visits, and customer meetings to identify project requirements.
* Support the development of solutions involving machinery installation, heavy lifting, mechanical works, and industrial relocation.

**Client Relationship & Key Account Management**

* Develop and maintain relationships with Plant Heads, Procurement Directors, CAPEX decision-makers, and industrial customers.
* Manage existing accounts while identifying opportunities for additional services and repeat business.
* Build long-term partnerships with key customers and international OEMs.
* Coordinate customer vendor registration and onboarding processes.

**Commercial Negotiations & Project Coordination**

* Lead commercial negotiations, including pricing, payment terms, project schedules, and contractual conditions.
* Work closely with Operations, Project Management, Supply Chain, HSE, and Finance teams to ensure a smooth transition from sales to project execution.
* Ensure commercial commitments are aligned with project delivery capabilities and company standards.

**Market Intelligence & Reporting**

* Monitor market developments, competitor activities, industrial investments, and emerging business opportunities.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, sales forecasts, and pipeline reports.
* Provide regular updates to management on sales activities, business opportunities, and market trends.
* Contribute to business planning and sales growth strategies for the Indian market.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering (BE/B.Tech) or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering (DME).
* **8–12 years of experience**
  in technical sales, project sales, or business development within industrial engineering or related sectors.
* Proven experience in selling industrial services such as machinery installation, factory relocation, turnkey mechanical projects, piping, fabrication, or equipment erection.
* Strong network within industrial sectors such as Automotive, FMCG, Chemicals, Metals, Food & Beverage, Building Products, Battery Electrification, Data Centres, Paper & Packaging, or Warehouse Automation.
* Good technical understanding of mechanical engineering, industrial equipment, manufacturing processes, and project execution.
* Experience managing complex technical proposals, commercial negotiations, and B2B sales cycles.
* Strong business development, relationship-building, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with technical and operational teams.
* Good understanding of HSE standards and safety requirements within industrial environments.

Why Join Us?

At Beck & Pollitzer, you will have the opportunity to work with a global engineering services company, supporting major industrial customers and contributing to complex and challenging projects.

We offer an international working environment where technical expertise, collaboration, and professional development are valued.

You will play an important role in expanding our business in India while working alongside experienced professionals across our global operations.

Join Us!

If you are passionate about technical sales, industrial engineering, and developing new business opportunities, we would like to hear from you.

**Apply today and become part of Beck & Pollitzer!**

*Beck & Pollitzer is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive working environment where everyone is treated with respect and has the opportunity to succeed.*

Manager/Senior Manager, Existing Business Sales
  
  
**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
**What your responsibilities will be**

+ Capture the voice of the customer and partner with Product, Support, and Marketing on fixes and campaigns.

+ Maintain accurate CRM hygiene, forecasts, and activity logs.

What You’ll Need To Be Successful
  
  
**What Success Is**

* Renewal rate/GRR at or above target; NRR growth across your book
* Reduced logo and revenue churn through early risk identification and save plays
* Improved product adoption and feature use in your segment
* Reliable forecast accuracy and, error-free renewals
* High customer satisfaction and reference ability

**What You'll Bring**

* SaaS renewals and account management experience with experience hitting retention and expansion targets.
* Negotiation and objection handling skills with procurement and decision makers.
* Data-driven operating rhythm using CRM (e.g., Salesforce) and sales tooling to prioritize and oversee at scale.
* Clear Experience establishing communication and engagement with prospects.
* Process discipline with comfort.
* Collaboration with Success, Support, Product, and Marketing.
* 3+ years of experience with customer health scoring, strategy design, and the tax compliance domain.
* You will be completely onsite in Pune and require working from the office.

Avalara is an AI-first Company
  
  
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
  
  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You
  
  
Total Rewards
  
  
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
  
  
Health & Wellness
  
  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
  
  
Inclusive culture and diversity
  
  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
  
  
**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
  
  
We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.
  
  
We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
Business Development Executive, Inside Sales (B2B)

Full-time · Pune, work from office · 6 days a week · Freshers and 0–2 years' experience · Up to ₹4 LPA fixed + monthly incentives

About Grimbell

Grimbell is a full-stack growth agency. We help B2B founders and businesses grow by building their sales pipeline. Our clients range from pharma consulting and edtech to food supply chain and quantum hardware.

Learn more at grimbell.com.

Role summary

You will be the voice of Grimbell on the phone, talking to founders and business owners, not retail customers. This is B2B sales, not loan, insurance or credit card calling. Half your day goes to inside sales for Grimbell's own services; the other half goes to calling customers and prospects on behalf of our clients.

This is a high-volume calling role: you will make 100+ calls a day, qualify leads, book meetings and keep the CRM clean. If you enjoy talking to people, handle rejection well and like seeing your numbers grow, this role is for you.

Key responsibilities

**Inside sales for Grimbell**

* Make outbound calls to B2B founders and decision-makers from lead lists, LinkedIn and inbound enquiries
* Pitch Grimbell's offerings
* Qualify leads on need, budget, decision-maker and timeline
* Book discovery calls and meetings for the Grimbell founders and sales team
* Follow up on proposals, missed calls and warm leads until a clear yes or no

**Customer calling for Grimbell's clients**

* Run calling campaigns for client businesses: lead qualification, appointment setting, product pitches, feedback and surveys
* Learn each client's product, script and FAQs quickly and represent their brand professionally
* Share call outcomes and customer feedback with the client team

**Across both**

* Make 100+ quality calls per day and meet daily and weekly targets
* Log every call, outcome and next step in the CRM the same day
* Send follow-up WhatsApp messages and emails after calls
* Handle objections and keep conversations positive, even after a no
* Share weekly insights on what's working: common objections, best pitch lines, lead quality

Who we're looking for

**Must-haves**

* Clear, confident spoken English and Hindi
* Comfortable making 100+ calls a day, every working day
* Willing to work from our Pune office, 6 days a week
* Thick skin: takes rejection in stride and keeps dialling
* Basic computer skills: Google Sheets/Excel, email, WhatsApp, any CRM
* Graduate in any stream

**Good to have**

* 1+ year in tele-sales, telecalling, inside sales
* Experience selling B2B services or calling business owners

**Traits we value**

* Curious and quick to learn new products
* Organised: follows up on time without reminders
* Honest about numbers and outcomes
* Wants to grow into a senior sales or account role

What you'll get

* Up to ₹4 LPA fixed, plus monthly incentives on meetings booked and deals closed
* Hands-on training on sales calling, objection handling and B2B selling
* Exposure to many industries through our client campaigns
* A clear growth path to SDR or Account Manager within 12–18 months, based on performance

* POSITION DESCRIPTION

**JOB TITLE**
Territory Sales Head-Branch Banking
  
  
**GRADE**
: AVP-I
