Retail Liabilities & TASC
  
  
**LOCATION**
: Pan India
  
  
**SUB-DEPARTMENT**
Branch Banking
  
  
**TYPE OF POSITION**
: Full-time
  
  
**REPORTS TO**
State Sales Head-Branch Banking
  
  
**REPORTING INTO**
Branch Sales Manager
  
  

* ROLE PURPOSE & OBJECTIVE

* The Territory Sales Head is responsible for overseeing the entire sales ecosystem within a defined geographic territory, ensuring the achievement of business targets across products, customer segments, and sales channels.
* This is a pure sales leadership role, sharply focused on acquisition, balance growth, cross-sell, and revenue maximization from liability products.
* The Territory Sales Head oversees and drives the performance of Branch Sales Managers (BSMs), ensuring each branch meets and exceeds its liabilities targets.
* The Territory Sales Head plays a pivotal role in driving new business acquisition, deposit mobilization, and cross-sell initiatives while ensuring alignment with the bank’s overall retail and branch banking strategy.
* This role is pivotal in ensuring the territory’s sales teams operate at peak productivity, leveraging both human and digital channels, and maintaining a competitive edge in the local market.
* The role demands strong leadership, sharp business acumen, and the ability to drive performance through teams.
* SIZE OF THE ROLE

**FINANCIAL SIZE**
**NON-FINANCIAL SIZE**

* Entire portfolio for the region – 50 Crs
* Customer size: 2000
* TPP income: 2.5 Crs
* Forex Fee income: 50 Lacs
* Other income such as MF etc: 25 Lacs
* Team Span – 10 Branch Sales Managers
* Branch Coverage – 10 to 12 branches
* KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE ROLE

**Business/ Financials**

* Define and execute a territory-level sales strategy aligned with state and regional business goals, focusing on liability growth and fee income.
* Set territory-wide sales targets across products and monitor sales productivity and pipeline health across all branches and sales teams within the territory.
* Drive initiatives to improve productivity per salesperson, ensuring sales targets are met through both branch-generated and field-generated business.
* Champion cross-sell initiatives, ensuring deeper customer engagement and maximizing wallet share across the portfolio.
* Identify new business opportunities, including sourcing new-to-bank (NTB) customers, deepening existing relationships, and driving wallet share growth.

**Customer**

* Ensure customer acquisition efforts prioritize quality over quantity, focusing on sourcing long-term, profitable relationships.
* Work closely with BSMs to ensure timely customer outreach via calls, emails, digital platforms, and in-person meetings.
* Drive initiatives to increase customer retention and relationship deepening, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction.
* Oversee initiatives to reduce customer attrition and dormant accounts through proactive engagement strategies.
* Coordinate with branches to deliver superior customer service and promptly address sales-related service issues or escalations.

**Internal Process**

* Ensure branches and teams adhere to ethical sales practices, avoiding mis-selling and ensuring transparent customer communications.
* Conduct periodic territory-level sales reviews to identify gaps and implement corrective actions.

title: Product Sales Manager
description:
Product Sales Manager – Anjuman
  
  
Company: JASIQ Labs Pvt. Ltd.
  
Product: Anjuman
  
Experience: 0–5 Years
  
Employment Type: Full-Time
  
Work Mode: Remote (Work from Anywhere)
  
Salary: Open to Negotiation (Based on Experience and Interview)
  
  
About JASIQ Labs
  
  
JASIQ Labs Pvt. Ltd. is a technology company focused on developing digital products and software solutions that solve real-world operational challenges and help organisations adopt digital transformation.
  
  
About Anjuman
  
  
Anjuman is a multi-tenant digital management platform designed to simplify and digitalise the operations of Trusts, Anjumans, Masjids, Madrasas and Idaras.
  
  
The platform provides centralised management of administrative, educational, financial and operational activities.
  
  
Key Product Areas:
  
  
- Trust Management: Trust administration, multiple unit management, committee members, President, Vice President, Secretary, Treasurer and staff management.
  
- Masjid Management: Donations, Chanda collection, expenses, Imam, Muazzin, staff and committee management.
  
- Madrasa / Idara Management: Student admissions, classes, teachers, attendance, fee collection, donations and educational activities.
  
- Financial Management: Donations, income, expenses, fee collections, digital receipts and financial reports.
  
- Institution Management: Members, employees, staff, students, records and daily operations.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented Product Sales Manager who understands how Trusts, Anjumans, Masjids, Madrasas and Idaras operate.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for identifying potential institutions, connecting with their decision-makers, understanding their existing management challenges and convincing them to adopt Anjuman for digitalising their operations.
  
  
This role requires both domain understanding and practical sales skills. We are looking for someone who can understand institutional workflows, build relationships and drive product sales, rather than just perform routine telecalling.
  
  
Key Roles & Responsibilities
  
  
1. Domain Understanding
  
  
- Understand the functioning of Trusts, Masjids, Madrasas, Idaras and their committees.
  
- Understand the roles of Presidents, Vice Presidents, Secretaries, Treasurers, Imams, Madrasa Heads, teachers and administrators.
  
- Understand how institutions manage donations, Chanda, expenses, admissions, fees, students, staff and employees.
  
- Identify opportunities to digitalise existing manual processes.
  
  
2. Lead Generation & Outreach
  
  
- Identify potential Trusts, Anjumans, Masjids, Madrasas and Idaras.
  
- Find and connect with the right decision-makers.
  
- Generate leads through Google Maps, online research, directories and other channels.
  
- Conduct cold calls, WhatsApp outreach, emails and follow-ups.
  
- Build and maintain a database of potential institutions.
  
  
3. Product Sales & Conversion
  
  
- Understand Anjuman's features, modules and workflows.
  
- Explain how Anjuman simplifies Trust, Masjid and Madrasa management.
  
- Demonstrate donation, financial, committee, student, admission and fee management features.
  
- Conduct online or in-person product demonstrations whenever required.
  
- Handle customer queries, objections and negotiations.
  
- Convert interested prospects into active customers.
  
  
4. Relationship Management
  
  
- Build relationships with Trust members, committee representatives and institutional administrators.
  
- Coordinate product demonstrations and customer onboarding.
  
- Collect customer feedback and communicate requirements to the internal team.
  
- Explore referral and partnership opportunities.
  
  
5. Sales Reporting
  
  
- Maintain daily calling and outreach records.
  
- Track leads, meetings, demonstrations and conversions.
  
- Prepare regular sales performance reports.
  
  
Required Skills & Qualifications
  
  
- Good understanding of Trust, Anjuman, Masjid, Madrasa and Idara operations.
  
- Knowledge of committee structures, institutional administration and financial workflows.
  
- Understanding of donation management for Trusts, Masjids and Madrasas.
  
- Strong communication, convincing and negotiation skills.
  
- Confidence in cold calling and approaching senior decision-makers.
  
- Ability to explain software products to non-technical customers.
  
- Good command of Hindi and English; Urdu will be an added advantage.
  
- Basic knowledge of Google Sheets, Excel and CRM tools.
  
- Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  
  
Preferred Candidate Profile
  
  
- Experience in B2B Sales, SaaS Sales, Software Sales or Institutional Sales.
  
- Existing connections with Trust members, Masjid committees, Madrasa administrators or community organisations will be an advantage.
  
- Freshers with strong domain knowledge, communication skills and sales aptitude are welcome.
  
  
What We Expect
  
  
We are looking for someone who can:
  
  
- Understand how these institutions actually work.
  
- Identify their administrative and financial management challenges.
  
- Find and approach the right decision-makers.
  
- Explain how Anjuman can digitalise their operations.
  
- Generate qualified leads, conduct product demonstrations and successfully close sales.
  
- Build long-term institutional relationships and contribute to Anjuman's market expansion.
  
  
Important: We are not looking for a generic telecaller. We need someone who understands the institutional ecosystem, knows how to approach decision-makers, can communicate the product's value and convert opportunities into customers.
  
  
How to Apply?
  
  
Interested candidates can apply by sharing their updated resume along with a brief introduction highlighting their sales experience, domain knowledge and relevant institutional connections.
  
  
Company: JASIQ Labs Pvt. Ltd.
  
Position: Product Sales Manager
  
Product: Anjuman
  
Work Mode: Remote
  
Experience: 0–5 Years
  
Salary: Negotiable, based on experience and interview.
  
  
Join JASIQ Labs and help bring digital transformation to Trusts, Masjids, Madrasas and community institutions through Anjuman.

title: Cafe Partnerships Associate, Food and Beverage
description:
I am looking for a serial cafe hopper in Pune.

I run Blendonomics. We supply coffee beans, hot chocolate and beverage products to cafes across India. Pune is already one of our important markets, and I am spending time here to grow it: more cafes on board, and a strong distributor network across the city.

I need one person on the ground who loves cafes as much as I do.

This is not a target-pushing sales job. You will be the person Pune cafes know from Blendonomics. You visit cafes, run tastings, listen to owners and baristas, and help them decide if our products fit their menu. What you hear in the field comes straight to me and our head office team, and it shapes what we do next.

What you will do

• Visit cafes across Pune that have asked to try our products, and find new ones on your own beat.

• Run tastings and explain the product in clear, honest terms.

• Find out what works on a cafe's menu, what worries the owner, and what they need.

• Log every visit the same day and send a short field report every week.

• Follow up with cafes so they keep ordering because the product works for them.

• Work with me, our head office team and our distribution partners in Pune.

You must have

• Some experience in or with cafes, restaurants, hotels, catering, food delivery or food brands. Any role counts: barista, floor staff, kitchen, outlet operations, restaurant onboarding, food sales, food content, internships or part-time work.

• Good spoken and written English. Marathi and Hindi too.

• A two-wheeler and a valid licence, and you are happy to be on the road most days.

• You live in Pune.

• You are available full-time. This role does not suit students in regular day college.

What you get

• A core-team role. You work directly with me.

• Fixed pay based on your experience, fuel support, and earnings on every order from cafes you bring in.

• A trial period to start. If it works, a full-time role with a clear path to lead the Pune market.

• Hands-on training in the cafe business, our products and B2B sales.

How to apply

Apply on LinkedIn with your resume and answer the screening questions. My team calls shortlisted candidates first, then we meet for an interview.

title: Manager-Admissions and Outreach
description:
**Job Opening: Manager – Admissions and Outreach**

**Reports to:**
Head – Marketing and Admissions

**Location:**
Nayanta University Campus, Bavdhan, Pune, Maharashtra 411021

**Nature and Days of Work:**
Full-time, On-site (Monday to Friday; flexibility required for events and travel)

**About Nayanta University**

Nayanta University is a multidisciplinary higher education initiative of the Nayanta Education Foundation, built in partnership with the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) to bring together academia and industry. It is founded by a group of distinguished industry and academic leaders — including Kris Gopalakrishnan, Dr Naushad Forbes (Chancellor), Banmali Agrawala, Bharat Puri, Dr Farhad Forbes, Meher Pudumjee, Dr Ashok Misra, Dr Pankaj Chandra, Nadir Godrej, Ramesh Mangaleswaran, and Dr Satish Reddy — with Dr Ranjan Banerjee as Vice-Chancellor. Nayanta's purpose is to develop curious, ethical, and responsible leaders who can contribute to a fairer and more sustainable world.

The University blends arts, sciences, and technology with real-world problem-solving, offering undergraduate programmes and lifelong learning options built around four pillars: Care (mentorship and personalised development), Curiosity (a culture of inquiry and original thinking), Confidence (immersive, project-based learning that builds leadership and communication skills), and Careers (three one-month sector immersions — corporate, social, and government — followed by a five-month internship). Nayanta is committed to recruiting capable students from every socio-economic background and to building an open, collaborative academic community.

**Why Join Us?**

* Student-Centred Impact: Shape how prospective students and families experience Nayanta, from first contact through to enrolment and the first day on campus.
* Ownership from the Ground Up: Build and run the student admissions and retention engine for a growing university, with the autonomy to design strategy as well as execute it.
* Collaborative Culture: Work closely with academic, marketing, operations, and admissions teams in a dynamic, purpose-driven environment.
* Professional Growth: Gain depth in admissions strategy, student and parent engagement, retention, events, and student recruitment within a fast-growing institution.

**Role Overview**

The Manager – Admissions and Outreach will own the end-to-end student admissions process and the retention of admitted students for Nayanta University. The role combines disciplined, applicant-facing admissions management and sustained engagement with admitted students and their families through to enrolment, with planning and communications for outreach events — leading the admissions counselling and outreach team to bring in, and retain, a strong, diverse cohort of students each year.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Outreach Events and Communications**

* Support the outreach strategy in line with Nayanta's enrolment goals, with a focus on planning and executing outreach events — webinars, campus tours, school visits, and education fairs.
* Own communications for outreach events — invitations, reminders, and follow-ups across email and WhatsApp — and maintain a communication tracker to ensure timely, consistent messaging to students, parents, schools, and counsellors.
* Maintain school and counsellor databases built from past applications and enrolments, and use them for targeted event communications.
* Represent Nayanta University professionally at external events, fairs, and school engagements.

**2. Admissions Process Management**

* Own the execution and continuous improvement of the end-to-end admissions process, from application review and shortlisting through entrance tests, interviews and the release of offers.
* Manage the external interface with applicants and parents, and the internal approval workflow, ensuring a smooth, transparent, and timely process.
* Liaise with internal teams (academics, operations, finance) and external partners to resolve issues in real time through the admissions cycle.
* Oversee invoicing and the fee payment process for admitted students.

**3. Applicant and Family Engagement and Retention**

* Ensure prospective students and parents receive timely, accurate guidance through every stage of the admissions journey — inquiry, application, interview, and offer.
* Design and oversee engagement touchpoints — counselling sessions, parent interactions, webinars, welcome meets, and campus tours — to support conversion from inquiry to enrolment.
* Track applicant engagement using CRM tools, ensuring timely follow-up and a well-documented, data-driven funnel.
* Own the retention of admitted students from offer to enrolment — addressing student and parent queries and concerns, including on fees, deferments, and withdrawals, in a timely and empathetic manner.
* Design and oversee pre-joining engagement touchpoints for admitted students and families, and track drop-offs to minimise attrition before the start of the academic year.

**4. Team and Stakeholder Leadership**

* Coordinate closely with Marketing, Academics, and University leadership to align event messaging, admissions criteria, enrolment targets, and retention goals.
* Report regularly on event participation, funnel conversion, retention, and admissions progress to University leadership.

**5. Insights and Continuous Improvement**

* Collect and analyse feedback on messaging, events, the applicant experience, and reasons for drop-offs, and recommend changes to improve conversion and retention for subsequent admission cycles.
* Stay current on competitor positioning and trends in student recruitment and retention.

The stated responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of duties.

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree required (Education, Psychology, Communications, or Management preferred); a Master's degree is an advantage.

**Experience**

* 4–6 years of experience in student admissions, outreach, counselling, or recruitment within higher education, schools, or ed-tech organisations, including experience managing a process or team end to end.
* Demonstrated experience addressing student and parent queries and supporting the retention of admitted students through to enrolment.
* Prior exposure to CRM-driven admissions funnels, event coordination and communications, and conversion tracking from inquiry to enrolment.

**Technical & Functional Competencies**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* High organisational capability with close attention to detail.
* Working knowledge of CRM tools and strong Excel proficiency; comfort with data-driven funnel management.
* Ability to manage multiple events, communications, timelines, and stakeholder relationships simultaneously.
* Familiarity with school networks and education-sector trends.

**Leadership & Personal Attributes**

* Warm, engaging, and student-focused communication style, with the gravitas to also lead a team.
* Strategic and highly organised, with the ability to manage complex, multi-stage processes end to end.
* Empathy, patience, and confidence in addressing student and parent concerns.
* A genuine belief that access to the right education, at the right moment, can change what someone is capable of.
* Professional presence, with strong relationship-building and people-leadership skills.

**Remuneration**

Compensation will be competitive and benchmarked to industry and sector norms, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

**Application Process**

Interested candidates may email their CV in PDF format to careers@nayanta.edu.in with the subject line: Application for Manager – Admissions and Outreach.

description:
**About KrushiSarthi**

**KrushiSarthi is India’s first AI-powered agro agency management system**
. We help fertilizer, seed and pesticide dealers run their entire shop from one app, and we are replacing slow, manual billing software with something that feels modern.

**What makes it stand out:**

* **AI Purchase Entry:**
  Upload a supplier invoice and the AI fills in everything, including batch, expiry and manufacture dates. A job that takes about 2 hours by hand is done in minutes.

  Automatic WhatsApp reminders for credit customers, sent in a way that keeps the shopkeeper’s own number safe.
* **GST-ready billing:**
  E-invoice and e-way bill support, dynamic QR on invoices, and bill-wise and item-wise profit and loss.

We are looking for a driven Sales Representative to bring KrushiSarthi to agro dealers across India. You will connect with shop owners, show them what the product can do, and help them switch from old software or paper registers to KrushiSarthi. This is a fully remote role. You work from home, we give you the product, the pitch and the support to sell it.

* Reach out to agro shop owners and agencies through calls, WhatsApp and video calls

**What We Are Looking For**

* Comfortable with technology: you can learn a new app quickly, screen-share, use WhatsApp Business, Google Meet, and Excel or Google Sheets without help
* Strong communication skills and confidence on calls

* Self-motivated, disciplined, and able to work independently from home
* Sales experience is a plus. Freshers with great communication and hunger to learn are welcome.

**Why Join Us**

* Sell a genuinely new kind of product with no true AI competitor in the agro billing space
* 100% work from home
* Grow with a fast-moving product
* Real ownership: your results are visible and rewarded

**How to Apply**

Send your resume and a short note on why you would be great at this role to info.krushisarthi@gmail.com Please mention the languages you speak.

**Gold Valuation & Loan Assessment**

* Coordinate gold purity testing, weighing, and valuation through authorized personnel or approved processes – Approved LTV, applicable credit policy. Etc.
* Ensure proper recording of gold ornaments, valuation details, and loan eligibility before disbursement.

**Loan Disbursement & Operational Controls**

* Coordinate loan approval and disbursement in accordance with the Bank’s delegated authority matrix and process guidelines.
* Ensure proper packing, sealing, labelling, documentation, and secure transfer of pledged gold to the designated vault/custodian.
* Maintain accurate records and ensure adherence to maker-checker controls and segregation of duties.

**Portfolio Servicing & Collections**

* Track loan repayment schedules, overdue accounts, renewals, and eligible top-up requests.
* Follow up with customers for timely repayment and coordinate with the collections team for delinquent accounts.
* Support loan closure, repayment reconciliation, and timely release of pledged gold upon fulfilment of applicable requirements.

**Compliance Risk and Audit.**

* Adhere to the Bank’s gold loan policy, SOPs, KYC/AML requirements, and applicable RBI guidelines.
* Ensure compliance with prescribed controls for gold custody, inventory reconciliation, audit trails, and collateral release.
* Support internal and external audits, inspections, and operational reviews, and ensure timely closure of observations.
* Immediately escalate any suspected fraud, gold-related discrepancies, process deviations, or operational risks.

title: Property Consultant
description:
**Company Description**
Self-employed property consultants operate independently, building and managing their own client base and portfolio of real estate opportunities. Working without the constraints of a large agency structure, they can offer flexible, tailored services to homebuyers, investors, and sellers. This environment allows for direct control over business strategy, client relationships, and income potential. The role is well suited for individuals who are motivated to grow their own brand, develop local market expertise, and deliver personalized guidance throughout real estate transactions.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Property Consultant role based in the Pune District. The Property Consultant will identify suitable properties for clients, conduct site visits, and provide detailed information on property features, pricing, and legal aspects. Responsibilities include managing inquiries, maintaining regular communication with clients, preparing proposals, and guiding clients through negotiations and closing processes. The role involves coordinating with developers, agents, and legal professionals, tracking market trends, and maintaining accurate records of leads, meetings, and completed deals. * Familiarity with local real estate regulations, documentation processes, and property valuation methods is beneficial.
* Ability to work on-site in Pune District, manage multiple client engagements, and prioritize tasks effectively.

* Previous experience in real estate, consulting, or a related client-facing role is an advantage.
* A relevant diploma or degree in business, real estate, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory when balanced by strong practical experience.

**Job Summary**
The Senior Sales Reporting Analyst role will assist with development and support reporting, analytics, and insights for the Sales organization. This role will partner closely with Sales leadership, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Data & Analytics to translate business needs into accurate, scalable, and actionable reporting solutions.
  
  
The role will have a strong focus on Salesforce reporting and analytics, while also supporting enterprise sales reporting across other data sources. The Senior Sales Reporting Analyst will support reporting across pipeline, bookings, invoiced performance, forecasting, customer performance, and other key sales metrics while helping ensure consistency in data, definitions, and reporting across platforms.
  
  
The ideal candidate has strong experience with Salesforce reporting and sales analytics, a solid understanding of B2B sales processes, and the ability to translate business questions into clear, scalable reporting and insights.
  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Design, build, and maintain sales reports, dashboards, and analytics for Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, and executive leadership
* Develop and maintain Salesforce reports and dashboards supporting pipeline, opportunity management, forecasting, sales activity, and performance reporting
* Partner with business stakeholders to gather reporting requirements and translate them into scalable reporting and analytics solutions
* Support Quote-to-Cash reporting and analytics, including pipeline, bookings, backlog, invoiced revenue and gross profit, forecasting, win/loss, and sales performance metrics
* Analyze sales performance across key dimensions including AE, Sales Director, region, practice, customer, product, manufacturer/OEM, and opportunity
* Identify trends, risks, exceptions, and opportunities within sales data and help translate findings into actionable business insights
* Ensure data accuracy and consistency by validating Salesforce data, business definitions, hierarchies, and downstream reporting
* Support the definition and governance of key Sales KPIs, business rules, hierarchies, and reporting definitions
* Maintain and document report logic, filters, calculations, data sources, and metric definitions to support governance and self-service reporting
* Troubleshoot reporting issues, including data quality, permissions, hierarchy, and visibility challenges
* Support Salesforce releases, enhancements, and process changes by assessing and validating reporting impacts
* Collaborate with Data Engineering and BI teams to align Salesforce reporting with enterprise data models, the data warehouse, Power BI, and other downstream analytics
* Help drive adoption of standardized enterprise reporting and reduce reliance on manual or duplicative reporting

**Required Skills/Abilities/Competencies**

* Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce reporting and dashboards, including standard, custom, summary, matrix, and joined reports
* Solid understanding of the Salesforce data model, including objects such as Opportunities, Accounts, Leads, Contacts, and Activities
* Strong experience with sales metrics, pipeline management, forecasting, bookings, and performance reporting
* Experience translating business requirements into reporting, dashboards, and actionable analytics
* Experience working with BI and visualization platforms; Power BI experience strongly preferred
* Ability to work with complex filters, business rules, hierarchies, row-level visibility, and sharing/security models
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to data accuracy and detail
* Ability to identify trends and exceptions within data and communicate their business impact
* Ability to clearly communicate insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Working knowledge of enterprise data warehouses and dimensional data models preferred
* SQL experience preferred

**Education And Experience**

* 4–7 years of experience in Salesforce reporting, sales analytics, business intelligence, Revenue Operations analytics, or a related field
* Hands-on experience supporting Sales or Revenue teams in a B2B environment
* Experience working across Salesforce and enterprise BI/data platforms strongly preferred
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Analytics, Data Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* Salesforce certifications (e.g., Salesforce Administrator, Advanced Administrator, or Reporting & Dashboard Specialist) are a plus
* Power BI or related analytics certifications are a plus

**Core Skills & Attributes**

* Strong business acumen with the ability to connect sales data and metrics to business outcomes
* Analytical mindset with the ability to move beyond producing reports to identifying insights, trends, risks, and opportunities
* Detail-oriented with a strong focus on data accuracy and consistency
* Strong stakeholder-management skills with the ability to work directly with Sales and business leadership
* Collaborative mindset with experience working cross-functionally across Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, Data Engineering, BI, and enterprise applications teams
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment
* Strong documentation and organizational skills
* Proactive, curious, and continuously looking for opportunities to improve and standardize reporting and insights

**Physical Requirements**

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.

title: Inside Sales Specialist
description:
**Company Description**

**Prorata**
is India’s first fractional car ownership platform, enabling individuals to co-own premium cars for leisure and lifestyle use by investing as little as 8.33% of the vehicle’s total cost. The model is structured around selling 12 ownership tickets per car, each providing 30 days of usage per year over 5 years, with the option to purchase up to 3 tickets for additional days. After 5 years, the car is sold to the highest bidder, and the resale value is shared among co-owners according to their ownership percentage.

Prorata forms local groups of interested co-owners within a defined radius and coordinates usage through its app, offering doorstep pickup and drop-off services. The platform is designed for occasional, experiential usage rather than daily commuting, and more information is available via the company’s app and website.

**Role Description**

This is a full-time
**Inside Sales Specialist role based in Pune**
, with a hybrid work arrangement that allows some work-from-home flexibility. The Inside Sales Specialist will handle inbound and outbound calls, engage prospective customers, explain Prorata’s fractional car ownership model, and convert qualified leads into paying co-owners.

Day-to-day responsibilities include managing lead pipelines, following up on app and web inquiries, scheduling and conducting online or phone-based product demonstrations, and maintaining accurate records in the CRM system. The role also involves coordinating with operations and marketing teams, addressing customer questions, ensuring a smooth onboarding experience, and supporting co-owners throughout their lifecycle to promote satisfaction and retention. The specialist is expected to meet sales targets, provide feedback on customer needs, and contribute to continuous improvement of sales processes.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Inside Sales skills with experience in consultative selling and closing deals over the phone or online channels.
* Candidates should possess Lead Generation and pipeline management skills, including prospecting, qualifying, and nurturing potential customers.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service and Customer Satisfaction skills, with a focus on building trust, resolving issues, and supporting long-term relationships.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills, including clear verbal and written communication and active listening abilities.
* Relevant experience in B2C sales, automotive, fintech, or subscription-based services is beneficial.
* Ability to work in a hybrid setup in Pune, manage time effectively, and use CRM and basic office software.

Hunger, ownership, and attitude matter more. You don’t have to be the person who knows everything on Day 1.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
**About Contlo**

**Contlo**
, part of QuestionPro, is autonomous marketing for e-commerce and B2C brands. A brand's own AI model and agents plan, write and run campaigns, customer journeys and conversations across WhatsApp, SMS, email and push, and are measured on revenue growth and retention rather than on software shipped.

We sell to D2C and B2C businesses on Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento and custom stacks: fashion, beauty, food, electronics, edtech, clinics and similar. WhatsApp is the lead channel in our core markets (India, the Gulf, LatAm and Europe), with COD order confirmation, RTO reduction and abandoned-cart recovery as the most common first use cases. Plans start at $49/month, so the buyer is usually a founder, marketing head or growth lead, not a procurement team.

**The role**

You are the first outbound hire. Your job is to build pipeline from scratch through cold calls, cold email and LinkedIn, and to book qualified demos for the founder-led sales team. There is no inbound queue to lean on yet; the lists, sequences and talk tracks you build in the first quarter become the outbound playbook for the SDRs who follow you.

You report to the founder (head of go-to-market) and work daily with marketing on messaging and target accounts. The role is a path to Account Executive within 12 to 18 months for someone who hits quota and learns the product.

**What you'll do**

* Build target account lists of D2C and B2C brands (Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento and custom stores) using Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Shopify app data and store-tech lookups, and keep them clean in the CRM.
* Make 50+ cold calls a day to founders, marketing heads and growth leads, open with a relevant hook (COD confirmation, RTO, abandoned carts, WhatsApp costs) and book a demo.
* Write and run multi-step cold email and LinkedIn sequences; test subject lines, hooks and send times, and keep what works.
* Qualify every booked meeting on store volume, channels in use, current tools (Klaviyo, Wati, Interakt, BiteSpeed, WebEngage) and timeline, and hand over clean notes to the AE.
* Work inbound and event leads within the hour: demo requests, pricing-page visitors, webinar and trade-show contacts.
* Log every touch in the CRM, keep pipeline stages accurate and report weekly on activity, meetings booked and meetings held.
* Feed what you hear on calls (objections, competitor names, pricing pushback, feature asks) back to marketing and product every week.
* Learn the product well enough to run a 10-minute first-look demo yourself when the AE is unavailable.

**What we're looking for**

* 1 to 3 years in an SDR, BDR or inside-sales role selling SaaS, ideally to e-commerce, D2C or SMB buyers. Strong freshers with a sales internship and a proven cold-calling record are welcome.
* Comfortable on the phone. You can take 30 rejections before lunch and still make the 31st call sound like the first.
* Writes short, specific emails in plain English that a busy founder will actually read.
* Knows how to research an account in five minutes: store platform, traffic, channels, current tools, recent launches.
* Disciplined with the CRM; every touch logged, every stage current, without being asked.
* Coachable and curious. You ask why a pitch landed or didn't, and change the next call because of it.
* Fluent English, spoken and written; Hindi or another Indian language is a plus for the India market.

**Nice to have**

* Sold or used marketing-automation or messaging tools: Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Wati, Interakt, AiSensy, BiteSpeed, WebEngage, MoEngage or CleverTap.
* Worked at or sold to a D2C brand or a Shopify agency and understands COD, RTO, repeat purchase and WhatsApp conversation pricing.
* Experience with Apollo, Lusha, Sales Navigator, HubSpot or Zoho CRM and a dialer such as Aircall or Kixie.

* Fluency in English and regional languages
* Experience with Gen AI, ML and Advanced Analytics
* Experience successfully selling enterprise database technologies, distributed systems, and similar products
* Deep understanding of distributed database technologies, including both analytic and transactional processing
* Expertise executing POCs, with experience designing and deploying complex technologies into existing customer environments
* In-Depth understanding of data platforms, including various competitive products (Oracle, SQL Server, Postgres, MongoDB, Snowflake, Databricks, etc.)

SingleStore is a global database company that empowers the world’s leading organizations to build and scale cutting-edge AI applications on a unified data platform that supports real-time transactions, analytics, and search. As a leader recognized by both Gartner and Forrester Wave, SingleStore serves the world ‘s leading data innovators including the top Fortune 500 enterprises. title: Business Development Manager
description:
We're hiring: Business Development Manager (On Ground), Turag.ai

Locations: Pan India. One BDM per region, across every state.

Salary: INR 25,000 to 35,000 per month fixed, plus monthly incentives and performance bonuses for hitting targets.

Turag.ai is the AI used car marketplace built by Blessing Softtech. Banks, NBFCs, dealers and individuals list cars on it. AI pricing tells sellers the best price for the model and car, buyers search in plain words, and AI inspection checks the car at human standard.

The role

You own a region. You go dealership to dealership, onboard dealers onto Turag.ai, and build the Turag brand across your area. Every month has a target. You hit it.

What you will own

• Onboarding used car dealerships in your region, from first visit to first live listing

• Monthly targets on dealer accounts created, active listings and the other metrics we track together

• Turag's brand presence in your area: dealer meets, auto markets, car hubs, local events

• A live map of every dealership in your region and where each one stands

• Dealer feedback back to our product team, every week

• A daily report of visits, accounts created and pipeline

What we look for

• Field sales or business development experience with numbers you can state: targets given, targets achieved

• Fluent in the local language of your region, plus Hindi or English

• Leadership: you run a territory without anyone watching

• Confident, positive, persistent. A "no" from a dealer is the start of the conversation

• Ready to be on the ground every working day

Strong plus

• Experience in the used car industry: dealerships, certified pre-owned, auto finance, repossession, used car platforms

• An existing network of dealers in your region

How to apply

Email hr@blessingsofttech.com with the subject line: BDM | State | City

Attach your CV and answer these three:

1. The biggest monthly target you were given in a field role, what you achieved, and how.

2. The area you would cover, and roughly how many used car dealers are in it. How did you get that number?

3. A dealer says: "I already list on other platforms. Why add one more?" Write your reply in your local language and in English.

Applications without the three answers are not reviewed. Every claim is checked live on the call and with references.

About Vijay InvestEdge

Established in 1994, Vijay InvestEdge is an AMFI-registered Mutual Fund Distributor based in Pune, built on the principles of trust, integrity, transparency, and long-term client relationships.

We believe wealth creation is not about chasing short-term returns or meeting transactional targets. It is about understanding clients’ financial goals, maintaining disciplined investment practices, and building lasting relationships that compound in value over time.

The Role: What You Will Own

* **Conduct structured portfolio reviews:**

* **Expand existing relationships:**

* **Take ownership of portfolio movements:**
  Monitor inflows, redemptions, and changes in client portfolios, proactively addressing concerns and strengthening investor confidence.
* **Ensure disciplined execution:**
  Work closely with research and operations teams to deliver timely, accurate, and consistent client service.
* **Maintain a structured approach:**

Who We’re Looking For

We are looking for an experienced professional who combines relationship-building skills with commercial awareness, investment knowledge, and an ownership mindset.

**Essential Experience**

* 7–10 years of experience in wealth management, mutual fund distribution, or a related financial services business.
* At least 7 years of relevant experience in business relationship management and mutual funds.
* Demonstrated ability to acquire clients, manage relationships, and grow a client portfolio.

**Skills and Mindset**

* Strong communication, networking, and relationship-management skills.
* A sound understanding of mutual funds, investment risk, asset allocation, and long-term investing.
* The ability to translate client requirements into suitable investment solutions within the applicable regulatory and distribution framework.
* A disciplined approach to follow-ups, portfolio reviews, and business development.
* Commercial awareness and the ability to identify opportunities for sustainable business growth.
* A self-driven, accountable, and ambitious approach to professional development.

* **Collaborative execution:**
  Partner with Research, Marketing and Operations to deliver a coordinated client experience.
* **Long-term career development:**
  Build expertise, strengthen client relationships, and grow alongside an expanding wealth distribution business.
* **A relationship-first culture:**
  Focus on trust, investor understanding, and sustainable business rather than purely transactional interactions.

We are building a platform where the right people can grow their professional capabilities, create lasting client relationships, and contribute meaningfully to the business.

Who Should Apply?

This opportunity is best suited to professionals who already understand the mutual fund distribution business and are ready to take greater ownership of client acquisition, portfolio growth, and relationship management.

**Education Qualification**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the complete sales cycle, from prospecting and lead generation to qualification, discovery, demonstrations, negotiations, and deal closure.
* Identify new business opportunities and build relationships with decision-makers, business leaders, and enterprise stakeholders.
* Develop account strategies and engage prospects through consultative selling.
* Maintain a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities and drive deals through each stage of the sales funnel.
* Lead commercial discussions, negotiate contracts, and close deals in line with company pricing and margin expectations.
* Team Leadership and Coaching
* Lead, mentor, and coach a team of Account Executives to achieve individual and collective sales targets.
* Balance personal selling responsibilities with team management and performance delivery.
* Conduct regular pipeline reviews, deal reviews, forecast discussions, and one-on-one coaching sessions.

* Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and consistent execution.

* Develop an understanding of regional market dynamics, customer needs, competitive positioning, and industry opportunities.
* Build relationships with key decision-makers and develop strategic accounts within the assigned territory.
* Identify opportunities for market expansion through direct sales, strategic accounts, and relevant partnerships.
* Adapt sales strategies to regional buying patterns, customer requirements, and commercial considerations.

* Maintain accurate pipeline data, opportunity stages, and sales forecasts in the CRM.
* Track team performance against quota, pipeline coverage, conversion rates, and deal velocity.
* Identify risks to revenue targets and take timely corrective action.
* Establish a disciplined sales cadence with regular pipeline reviews and clear next steps for every active opportunity.
* Collaborate with Marketing and Sales Development teams to improve lead quality, pipeline generation, and conversion.

* Work closely with Pre-Sales and Solution Consulting teams to deliver relevant product demonstrations and solution discussions.
* Partner with Marketing and Sales Development teams to improve prospect engagement and opportunity generation.
* Coordinate with Customer Success and other internal teams to support smooth customer transitions after deal closure.

* Forecast accuracy and CRM hygiene.
* Team productivity, coaching effectiveness, and improvement in individual performance.
* Growth in the EMEA customer base and strategic account penetration.

title: Business Development Manager - Environmental India (f/m/d)
description:
Your role
  
  
The Business Development Manager (BDM) India is responsible for driving sustainable growth within the Environmental Segment by identifying and developing market opportunities, building strategic customer and partner relationships, and expanding sales of integrated solutions for anaerobic digestion, manure management, and municipal and industrial wastewater treatment applications. The role combines commercial leadership, market development, strategic account management, channel partner support, and aftermarket growth to help customers improve operational efficiency, resource recovery, renewable energy production, and environmental sustainability.
  
  
Acting as the primary commercial lead for the Environmental Segment in India, the BDM develops and executes growth strategies, identifies new business opportunities, manages key accounts, and strengthens the regional partner network. In close collaboration with engineering, product management, manufacturing, and service teams in Germany and Italy, the BDM ensures the delivery of high-quality, value-driven solutions that address customer needs and support long-term business success.
  
  
The role is responsible for promoting the complete Environmental Segment portfolio, including pumps, mixers, separation technologies, modules, hygienizing biocells, relevant accessories, and lifecycle service offerings.
  
  
*Uniquely, this role will work closely with the Divisional Business Line Managers for Environmental, and the Sales Distribution Managers.*
Your day-to-day
  
  

* Identify and develop optimal revenue models, sales/distribution channels, pricing, and new product development strategies.
* Negotiate strategic partnerships.
* Prioritize and track investments across new product development initiatives.
* Share best practices and collaborate with colleagues across different departments to drive business success.
* Carry out a detailed analysis of the market in which the company operates to identify avenues for development: new markets, customers, growth areas, new trends etc.
* Devising and planning the strategic guidelines and short, medium and long-term sales actions needed to achieve the objective (identifying priority targets, key contacts, contact actions, follow-ups, etc.) for each targeted market.
* Accountable of the Turnover and the margin in the segment.
* Define commercial opportunities and identify market needs in order to increase the number of new project requests.
* Provide technical support, product selection guidance, and pump sizing recommendations.
* Conduct site visits, system audits, and troubleshooting support as needed.
* Train distributors and representatives on products, applications, and value‑propositions.
* Support project execution teams to ensure customer expectations and scope requirements are.
* Maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipeline reports, and CRM updates.
* Provide regular feedback to leadership regarding opportunities, risks, and product needs.

**Your Skills And Experience**
We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. We value diverse experiences and perspectives and are excited to see what you bring to the role.
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering preferred (Mechanical, Chemical, Industrial) or equivalent technical experience.
* 5–8 years of outside sales experience in industrial pumps, fluid‑handling equipment, rotating machinery, or engineered capital equipment.
* Knowledge of the market and the application required to set up the right commercial strategy.
* Strong understanding of fluid dynamics, pump sizing, and system design principles.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple deadlines.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and CRM tools.
* Willingness to travel extensively throughout the region.
* Bilingual Indi/English required; German and Italian is a plus.

**Your Compensation And Benefits**
We offer compensation that reflects the skills, experience, and responsibilities of the role. Pay also depends on the country where the job role is based, as compensation practices vary across our markets. During the recruitment process, we share clear information about the pay and benefits for your location, so you know what to expect before moving forward.
  
  
Your location
  
  
This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at our offices in either Pune, India or Wangen in Allgäu region, Germany or Correggio, Italy.
  
  
Why it is great to work with us
  
  
Your career grows through your skills, your curiosity, and the people you work with. You join a global network where we learn from each other and share knowledge openly. We focus on long‑term development and encourage you to explore new ideas that help us move forward. Innovation is part of how we think and act – we test, improve, and use what we learn to create solutions that matter. You can make a meaningful impact by contributing with your insights and taking ownership of your work, supported by flexible ways of working and leaders who empower you.

title: Business Development Intern
description:
About Blendonomics

Blendonomics supplies premium coffee beans, hot chocolate and beverage products to cafes across India. We are expanding our presence in Pune and looking for someone passionate about coffee, food and cafe culture to become part of our growing team.

The Opportunity

Are you someone who loves exploring new cafes, discovering unique coffee experiences and interacting with people?

Do you notice what's on the menu before noticing the cafe decor?

If yes, this opportunity is for you!

We are looking for a 
**Business Development Trainee**
 who will represent Blendonomics across Pune, build relationships with cafe owners, conduct product tastings and help expand our cafe and distributor network.

This is not a conventional target-driven sales role. It is about understanding the cafe ecosystem, building genuine relationships and helping businesses discover products that complement their menus.

Key Responsibilities

* Visit cafes across Pune that have expressed interest in our products and identify new potential cafe partners.
* Conduct product tastings and explain our coffee, hot chocolate and beverage offerings.
* Interact with cafe owners and baristas to understand their requirements, menu preferences and business challenges.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with cafe partners.
* Maintain daily records of cafe visits and submit weekly field reports to the head office.
* Follow up with cafe partners to encourage repeat orders and long-term relationships.
* Coordinate with the head office team and distribution partners to strengthen Blendonomics' presence in Pune.

Who Should Apply?

We are looking for someone who:

* Has a genuine interest in coffee, food and cafe culture.
* Enjoys exploring cafes and understanding different beverage offerings.
* Has strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Can communicate effectively in 
  **English, Hindi and Marathi**
  .
* Is proactive, self-motivated and consistent with follow-ups.
* Owns a two-wheeler and holds a valid driving licence.
* Is comfortable travelling across Pune for field visits.

**Educational Qualification:**
 Open to candidates from all educational backgrounds. We value interest, initiative and execution over degrees.

**Important:**
 This is a full-time opportunity and is not suitable for students attending regular day college.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work directly with the founder as part of the core team.
* Fixed compensation along with fuel support.
* Additional earnings on every order generated from cafes you onboard.
* Practical training in the cafe industry, beverage products and B2B business development.
* Opportunity to grow into a leadership role and eventually lead the Pune market.
* Initial trial period, followed by an opportunity for a full-time role based on performance.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply directly through LinkedIn with their updated resume.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited for a screening interview with our team.

**Expected Joining:**
 After the Diwali holidays.

Come Build the Cafe Ecosystem with Blendonomics!

If exploring cafes, meeting people and building meaningful business relationships sounds exciting to you, we would love to hear from you.

**About The Opportunity**
We are partnering with a global category leader in Physical AI and enterprise drone autonomy. Our client’s software platform powers mission-critical autonomous operations across 400+ large industrial sites in 70+ countries. Their customer roster includes Fortune 500 leaders across energy, utilities, security, and infrastructure (such as Shell, CSX, Airbus, Anglo American, Dole, and Statnett). The team operates at AI speed—where intelligence and autonomy are at the core of everything. They thrive in a high-agency, high-velocity environment where AI is not a side project, but the operating system for thinking, building, and growing.

Our client sells Physical AI: autonomous systems that detect failures in real-time, inspect critical infrastructure around the clock, and act before problems cascade.
  
  
Your buyers are energy companies, mining firms, and infrastructure operators making their first major investment in autonomous site intelligence. As the senior commercial leader in your region, you will own the full revenue picture: direct enterprise deals, the channel partner ecosystem, and commercial execution. This is not account management; this is building a market. You won't inherit pipeline—you will build the commercial systems that create it.

title: Call Center Sales Representative
description:
Appointment Setting, Call Centre, Customer Aquisition, Customer Service, Inside Sales, Outbound Sales, Sales
  
  
**Call Center Sales Representative**
**Schedule:**
Full-time, aligned with U.S. Eastern Time business hours
  
  
**Annual Target Earnings:**
C$40,000–C$50,000, based on performance
  
  
**Location:**
Remote
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Royal York Property Management is hiring Call Center Sales Representatives to speak with residential property owners about its rental-guarantee program.
  
  
The program costs C$100 per month. If a covered tenant defaults on rent, the program is designed to provide the owner with an amount equal to the property’s monthly rent, subject to the program’s terms, approval requirements, and claim conditions.
  
  
You will contact company-provided property-owner leads through an automatic dialer, ask qualification questions, respond to objections, and connect interested owners with a Royal York sales representative.
  
  
You will not complete the final sale or determine whether an owner is approved. Your responsibility is to gain the owner’s attention, explain the program, qualify the opportunity, and secure a live transfer.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Apply with your résumé. If your background aligns with the position, you will receive a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours.

description:
**Function:**
**Outbound Lead (Senior SDR), Job Description, Amura & Kylas**
**Experience: 3-4 Years**
**Location: Pune (On-Site)**
**About Amura**
Amura is India's leading growth and marketing company for B2B brands across the globe. We bring two decades of experience engineering growth for B2B businesses, with over $100M in ad spend managed across 300+ companies, and we are now expanding our own outbound into the US and EU.
  
  
**The role**
The Outbound Lead is an experienced SDR who runs Amura's outbound engine. You decide what gets sent, to whom, and why, and you check every week whether it is working.
  
  
You are the operator. You write the requirements, test what is built, watch the numbers and keep improving the system. You work closely with our Account Executive, who takes qualified leads into pitches, and with the marketing and service teams behind our standardised packages.
  
  
**What You Will Own**
You own four things: outbound results, the health of the outbound system, the junior SDR team, and the handoff to the AE.
  
  
**Outbound for the India and Global**

* Define the ideal customer profile, target account tiers and messaging for each of our standardised service packages in each market
* Plan and run outbound across cold calling, email and LinkedIn, including ABM plays for priority accounts
* Write and test sequences, offers and call scripts, and keep a log of what works by package and market
* Run outreach within GDPR, PECR and CAN-SPAM rules, with clean opt-out handling

**Running the system with the tech team**

* Turn what you need into clear briefs for the tech team: data sources, enrichment steps, sequences, routing rules and reports
* Test every build before it goes live and report issues with clear examples
* Watch deliverability, bounce and reply rates, lead response time and data quality, and raise problems early
* Keep the CRM (Kylas) clean, with lead stages and the definition of a qualified lead applied the same way every time

**Leading the junior SDRs**

* Set daily and weekly cadences, targets and call standards for the SDR team
* Run the calling team: listen to live and recorded calls, use a scorecard, refine scripts and call lists, and give regular feedback
* Coach on conversations, objection handling and qualification, using call and reply reviews
* Train the team to use AI tools for research and first drafts, with human review before anything is sent to priority accounts

**Handoff and reporting**

* Pass qualified leads to the AE with a short brief covering the account, the contact, the package of interest and what was discussed
* Publish a weekly report on meetings booked, qualified pipeline, cost per meeting and experiments run, in plain language that the founders can act on

**Tools you should know**
You use these tools daily as an operator. You do not need to build integrations yourself, because the tech team does that, but you should be able to set up and run campaigns end to end.
  
  
**Function**
**Tools**
**Level**
Email sequencing Instantly, Smartlead, Lemlist or similar Must know at least one Lead data and enrichment Apollo, Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator Must know Apollo or Clay Signal and data sourcing Clay, Apify, PhantomBuster, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Reddit and X data through APIs or scraping tools, job boards and directories Must know CRM Kylas, HubSpot or Salesforce Must know one, quick to learn Kylas Calling and LinkedIn A dialer or cloud calling tool, LinkedIn outreach Must know Email health SPF, DKIM, DMARC, Google Postmaster Tools, verification tools such as ZeroBounce or NeverBounce, multi-domain and mailbox setups Must understand at scale AI for research and drafts ChatGPT, Claude or similar Must know Reporting Google Sheets, CRM dashboards, Looker Studio Good to know Automation n8n, Make or Zapier at a basic level Plus
  
  
**Compliance basics.**
You should understand cold email rules for the US and EU: CAN-SPAM in the US, and GDPR and PECR in Europe, including lawful basis, opt-out handling and which contacts can be approached, plus the calling rules that apply to calls into the US and EU.
  
  
**What We Are Looking For**
We want someone with 3 to 4 years of outbound experience who has booked meetings with US or EU buyers and has run the system around it, not only the calls. Our goal is to reach 100,000 outbound emails a month, so we want people who have seen the challenges of running outbound at that scale.
  
  

* 3 to 4 years as an SDR, BDR or outbound specialist in B2B SaaS or services, selling to US or EU buyers
* Cold calling experience with US or EU prospects: getting past gatekeepers, handling objections, running a short discovery and booking meetings from calls
* A record of meetings booked and qualified pipeline, with numbers you can share
* Has run or worked closely on high-volume outbound and knows how to keep it healthy as volume grows: multiple domains and mailboxes, warmup, sending limits, bounces, spam complaints, blacklists, list decay and reply handling
* Builds lists from buying intent, not just filters. You know how to find signals such as hiring posts, job changes, funding, tech changes, LinkedIn posts and engagers, Reddit threads where people ask for recommendations, X posts and review sites, and turn them into prioritised lists with a reason to reach out
* Collects data from LinkedIn, Reddit, X, job boards and directories using tools like Clay, Apify, PhantomBuster, Sales Navigator and APIs, then cleans, verifies and enriches it
* Built your own sequences, lists and enrichment flows in tools such as Instantly, Apollo or Clay, and tracked reply rates and deliverability
* Brings fresh ideas on data sources, triggers and angles, and can show one non-obvious list or play of yours that produced meetings
* Experience with ABM or account-based outreach to named accounts

* Comfortable working hours that overlap with US and EU time zones
* Data-minded: you check the numbers, find what is not working and run tests to fix it

**Good to have**

* A background in marketing, such as demand generation, content, SEO, paid media or ABM, which helps you understand what we sell and write about it well

title: Business Development Executive
description:
**Business Development Executive**

**Coliving | Zolo**

**Own the cluster. Drive occupancy. Run the properties. Deliver the numbers.**

**Compensation:**
₹6.65 LPA (₹3.65 LPA Fixed + ₹3 LPA Performance-Linked Variable)

**Why this role exists**

Zolo's Coliving business operates through properties that need to perform every single day — commercially and operationally.

A property can be clean and well managed, but if beds remain vacant, the business does not perform.

It can achieve strong occupancy, but if resident experience and operations break down, customers leave.

As we scale, we need strong on-ground business owners who can bring
**Sales and Operations together**
and take responsibility for the complete performance of a cluster.

Each Cluster Business Manager will typically own
**approximately three Zolo properties**
.

This role exists to ensure that every property in the cluster:

* Maintains strong occupancy
* Converts available demand into bookings
* Creates local sales opportunities
* Delivers a strong resident experience
* Operates with discipline every day
* Resolves customer and operational issues quickly
* Has an accountable and high-performing property team

If the Cluster Business Manager is strong,
**beds get filled, residents stay, teams perform, and properties run well.**

If the Cluster Business Manager is weak,
**vacancies increase, sales opportunities get missed, complaints rise, and execution starts slipping.**

**Your mandate is clear**

* Own business performance across approximately 3 properties
* Drive Sales, bookings, and occupancy
* Convert walk-ins, leads, referrals, and local opportunities
* Identify and create new demand around your properties
* Own day-to-day property Operations
* Deliver strong resident experience and retention
* Lead and manage property-level teams
* Resolve customer and operational escalations
* Track performance numbers and take action when the cluster is behind target

This is not a property coordination role.

**You are the business owner for your cluster — responsible for both filling the properties and running them well.**

**About Zolo and Coliving**

Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent.

People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options.

Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.

Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living by bringing together professionally managed homes, essential services, technology, and community into one seamless experience.

Z Hotels serves the modern traveller with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline.

Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life.

Our ambition is to build the most trusted living and hospitality ecosystem for the new generation — delivering experiences customers can rely on while building properties that perform sustainably.

**What you will be responsible for**

**1. Own Cluster Business Performance**

* Take ownership of business performance across approximately 3 assigned properties
* Track occupancy, bookings, vacancies, move-ins, move-outs, and other key property metrics
* Understand which properties are performing and where intervention is required
* Build clear action plans for properties falling behind target
* Balance Sales performance with strong property Operations and resident experience
* Review numbers regularly and act quickly when performance moves off track

**2. Drive Sales, Conversion & Occupancy**

* Take direct ownership of occupancy across assigned properties
* Handle property walk-ins and convert prospects into bookings
* Follow up actively with interested prospects until closure
* Coordinate closely with Inside Sales teams on leads and conversions
* Understand customer requirements and recommend the right property / offering
* Track available inventory and actively work towards filling vacant beds
* Ensure leads do not get lost because of poor follow-up or property-level execution

**3. Build Local Demand**

* Understand the micro-market around each assigned property
* Identify colleges, offices, institutions, brokers, local businesses, and other potential demand sources
* Build relationships that can generate enquiries and referrals
* Drive resident referrals and other local lead-generation initiatives
* Identify opportunities to improve property visibility in the local market
* Continuously look for new ways to generate demand rather than depending only on centrally generated leads

**4. Own Property Operations**

* Ensure smooth day-to-day Operations across assigned properties
* Maintain property readiness, cleanliness, safety, and service standards
* Ensure rooms and beds are ready for prospective and incoming residents
* Identify operational gaps and drive quick resolution
* Coordinate Housekeeping, Maintenance, Security, and other property services
* Ensure operating issues do not negatively affect Sales, occupancy, or resident experience

**5. Own Resident Experience & Retention**

* Build strong relationships with residents across the cluster
* Handle complaints and escalations with ownership and urgency
* Ensure issues are resolved completely rather than simply forwarded to another team
* Identify recurring complaints and work towards permanent solutions
* Understand reasons for dissatisfaction and potential churn
* Build resident trust through visibility, responsiveness, and consistent follow-through
* Support resident engagement and community initiatives

**6. Lead the Property Team**

* Manage property-level staff across the assigned cluster
* Set clear expectations around Sales, service, discipline, and execution
* Allocate responsibilities and ensure daily activities are completed
* Review individual and property-level performance
* Coach team members where performance needs improvement
* Address underperformance and execution gaps early
* Build a team capable of running properties consistently without constant supervision

**7. Manage Through Numbers**

* Track Sales, occupancy, conversion, vacancy, customer experience, and Operations metrics
* Maintain visibility into performance across all assigned properties
* Understand why targets are being missed rather than only reporting the gap
* Prioritise properties and issues requiring immediate intervention
* Maintain required trackers, systems, and reporting accurately
* Use numbers to decide where time and effort need to be focused

**What success looks like after 6–12 months**

* Strong and stable occupancy across assigned properties
* Consistent achievement of Sales and business targets
* Higher conversion of leads and walk-ins into bookings
* Strong local demand and referral pipeline
* Vacant beds are actively identified and worked upon
* Properties operate smoothly and consistently
* Resident complaints and recurring escalations reduce
* Resident satisfaction and retention remain strong
* Property teams have clear ownership and accountability
* Business and operational gaps are identified and corrected quickly
* The cluster performs without requiring constant intervention from senior leadership

The cluster operates through:

**Sales Hustle + Operational Discipline + Customer Ownership + Strong Execution**

**Who this role is for**

You will likely thrive here if:

* You enjoy Sales and get energy from converting opportunities
* You want your performance to directly influence what you earn
* You are comfortable being accountable for clear monthly targets
* You take ownership rather than waiting for someone to tell you what to do
* You enjoy being on the ground and interacting with customers
* You can manage both people and problems
* You are comfortable moving between multiple properties
* You can balance selling with running strong Operations
* You remain persistent when targets are difficult
* You want responsibility early in your career

**Experience we value**

We are open to
**high-potential freshers as well as candidates with 6 months – 1 year of Sales experience.**

Relevant exposure can include:

* Inside Sales
* Field Sales
* Business Development
* Real Estate / Property Sales
* Hospitality Sales
* Customer Acquisition
* Retail / High-Interaction Sales

For freshers, we will look strongly at:

* Sales orientation
* Communication and confidence
* Energy and hustle
* Comfort with targets
* Ownership mindset
* Ability to influence and convince people
* Willingness to work on ground and move across properties

**We are looking for someone who wants to sell, own outcomes, lead people, and eventually run a business — not someone looking only for an Operations role.**

**Compensation & Performance**

This is a strongly performance-linked role.

**Total Compensation: ₹6 LPA**

**₹3.65 LPA Fixed + ₹3 LPA Performance-Linked Variable**

The variable component will be linked to defined monthly performance outcomes.

This means strong performance has a
**direct and meaningful impact on your monthly**

**The impact you will have**

You will directly influence:

* Occupancy
* Sales & Revenue
* Lead Conversion
* Resident Experience
* Retention
* Property Operations
* Team Performance
* Cluster Business Performance

You won't own one small part of the customer journey.

**You will own what happens from prospect → booking → move-in → resident experience → retention across your cluster.**

**Why join now**

For someone early in their career, most roles ask you to execute one part of a business.

This role gives you the opportunity to
**own one.**

You will get hands-on exposure to:

**Sales + Operations + Customers + People + Business Numbers**

You will manage multiple properties, lead on-ground teams, own targets, solve customer and operational problems, and see the direct impact of your decisions on business performance.

Strong performers can grow into larger
**Area / City / Business Operations leadership roles**
as their scope expands.

**If you want responsibility early, enjoy Sales, and want your performance to determine both your growth and your earnings — this role is built for that.**

title: Business Development Manager, India
description:
Business Development Manager, India

Location: Pune, India, office-based

Team: Working alongside the DIPAX team in our Pune office

Employment: Full time

Pay: Competitive salary plus performance-related commission

This role is based in our Pune office, so you must live in or near Pune. You will be employed through our partner entity in India.

The opportunity

RoboShadow is a UK cybersecurity company with a simple mission: demystify cybersecurity by removing its cost and complexity. We help SMBs, MSPs and enterprise teams find security problems, fix them and prove they are protected.

We are now looking for someone to build RoboShadow's commercial presence in India. This is a hands-on business development role, and it could develop into our Head of Growth, India role.

You will speak with business owners, technology leaders, MSPs and security teams, learn how they manage cybersecurity today, find the gaps and help them build a sensible business case for improving it. You must enjoy picking up the phone, and you must be curious enough about technology to use RoboShadow, understand how it works and demonstrate it confidently.

What you will own

• Build your own pipeline through calls, email, LinkedIn, events, partnerships and referrals.

• Speak with SMBs, mid-market businesses, enterprise organisations, MSPs and MSSPs.

• Help customers understand their cybersecurity risks without fear or unnecessary jargon.

• Build clear business cases around reducing risk, automating work, consolidating tools and lowering security costs.

• Demonstrate the RoboShadow platform and explain its commercial value.

• Use company-provided AI tools to research markets, personalise outreach, produce campaigns and test new sales ideas.

• Run focused go-to-market experiments by industry, city, security problem or customer type.

• Manage opportunities properly in HubSpot and keep an honest, measurable pipeline.

• Develop relationships with Indian technology partners, MSPs and larger organisations.

• Help shape our pricing, positioning and growth plan for India.

How we will measure success

We will look at:

• The pipeline you build yourself, without relying on supplied leads.

• Customers won in India.

• The go-to-market experiments you run and what you learn from them.

• The accuracy and honesty of your pipeline in HubSpot.

• The partner and MSP relationships you develop.

Who we are looking for

We care more about ability, energy and judgement than job titles. Ideally, you will have:

• Experience selling technology, SaaS or cybersecurity products.

• Experience with mid-market or enterprise customers.

• Confidence making outbound calls and starting conversations.

• The ability to find and create opportunities without relying on supplied leads.

• Enough technical curiosity to learn the product properly.

• Strong written and spoken English.

• The ability to explain complicated cybersecurity problems in plain language.

• Experience using a CRM such as HubSpot.

• An interest in AI, automation and modern sales technology.

• The ambition to build a market, then lead the team that grows around it.

You are commercially sharp, but you do not use pressure or fear to sell. You listen, ask useful questions and help the customer reach a sensible decision. If an experiment fails, you learn from it and try the next one.

This role will not suit someone who only wants to manage existing accounts, avoids outbound calling, needs every lead supplied to them, or treats AI as a buzzword rather than a working tool.

Why join RoboShadow?

• Build a new market with support from an established international team.

• Work closely with the people who build the technology you are selling.

• Use AI and automation as part of your everyday job.

• Learn cybersecurity by working directly with the product and customers.

• Earn the chance to lead RoboShadow's growth in India.

• Help businesses protect themselves without making cybersecurity expensive, frightening or complicated.

Experience

Cybersecurity sales experience would be particularly valuable. We would also consider an exceptional technology salesperson who can prove they learn quickly and know how to sell business outcomes.

If you prove you can build a pipeline, win customers and understand the Indian market, we want you to grow into Head of Growth, India: owning the growth plan, recruiting a local team and developing partnerships. The opportunity is real, but the title will be earned through results.

How to apply

Please apply by email to liz@roboshadow.com, not through LinkedIn. Send us:

• Your CV.

• A link to a short Loom video (around 1 to 3 minutes) telling us why you would be a great fit for this role.

The Loom video is your first stage interview, so applications without one will not be considered. It does not need to be formal.
